3000.name: The Temple Library

north.description: The shelves to the north look slightly misaligned.
north.reveal_message: You slide the bookshelf aside, revealing a narrow passage north.

east.description: You see the Temple of Garathorm.

south.description: To the south lies The Hall of Champions.

west.description: To the west lies The Gate Of Fameland.

3000.description:
The Temple Library is a long marble hall lined from floor to vaulted
ceiling with oaken bookcases, their shelves crowded with tomes, scrolls
and bound records of the realm. Reading desks stand in rows beneath
hanging lamps, and a deep hush lies over everything. Archways lead north
to the Map Room and south to the Hall of Champions, the temple hall
opens east, and a door on the west gives onto The Gate Of Fameland. The
smell of old vellum and lamp oil fills the air.

3001.name: The Temple Of Garathorm

extra_descs.columns marble: Each marble block is taller than a man and fitted without mortar. Masons still argue about how the founders raised them.
extra_descs.walls hangings: The wall hangings chronicle the city's history in fading thread: the founding, the plague years, the dragon that never quite reached the gates.

3001.description:
This is the southern end of the temple hall in the Temple of Garathorm.
The temple has been constructed from giant marble blocks, eternal in
appearance, and most of the walls are covered by ancient wall paintings
picturing Gods, Giants and peasants. Large steps lead down through the
grand temple gate, descending the huge mound upon which the temple is
built and ends on the temple square below. To the west, you see the
Reading Room. The donation room is in a small alcove to the east. Dust
motes drift in the stale air. The ceiling hangs low overhead.

north.description: To the north lies The Gate Of The Inner City.

east.description: To the east lies By The Temple Altar.

south.description: You look down the huge stone steps at the temple square below.

west.description: You see the Reading Room.

up.description: To the up lies The Board Room of the Immortals.

3002.name: Clerics' Inner Sanctum

extra_descs.well: The well's rope is gone, but cold air breathes steadily up from the dark. Things echo down there for longer than they should.
extra_descs.altar picture thor: Thor glares down from the painting with the particular disapproval reserved for adventurers about to do something stupid.

3002.description:
This is the inner sanctum. A picture of the mighty Thor, is hanging on
the wall, just above the altar which is set against the western wall. A
well in the middle of the floor leads down into darkness. Vile smells
waft from the depths. A magnificent marble fountain gurgles peacefully
in the center of the square. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the
touch. The ceiling hangs low overhead.

east.description: You see your favorite place, the bar of divination.

3003.name: Clerics' Bar
3003.description:
The bar is one of the finest in the land, lucky it is members only. Fine
furniture is set all around the room. A small sign is hanging on the
wall. Dust motes drift in the stale air. The air is still and musty.

south.description: You see the entrance.

west.description: You see the inner sanctum.

3004.name: Entrance to the Clerics Guild
3004.description:
The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true nature of
the Clerics. The exit leads east to the temple square. A small entrance
to the bar is in the northern wall. The ceiling hangs low overhead.
Shadows gather in the corners.

north.description: You see the bar, richly decorated with really stylish furniture.

east.description: You see the Temple Square.

3005.name: The Temple Fountain

extra_descs.fountain: Coins pave the fountain's floor, each one a wish. The water stays sweet year round, which the clerics call a blessing and the engineers call good plumbing.
extra_descs.steps gate: The marble steps are worn into shallow bowls by ten thousand penitent feet.

3005.description:
This area is the temple square. Huge marble steps lead up to the temple
gate to the north. In the center of the square, a magnificent marble
fountain gurgles peacefully, its crystal waters catching the light. The
entrance to the Clerics' Guild is to the west, and the old Grunting Boar
Inn is to the east. The market square lies to the south, and the training grounds are to the west. A cold draft seeps up from cracks
between the stones beneath the stairs. The cobblestones are worn smooth
by countless feet. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: You see the temple.

east.description: To the east lies The Garathorm Donation Room.

south.description: To the south lies Northern End Of Market Square.

west.description: You see the entrance to the Clerics' Guild.

203006.name: Northern End Of Market Square

north.description: To the north lies The Temple Fountain.

east.description: To the east lies Inn Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Middle Of Market Square.

west.description: To the west lies Alchemy Street.

203006.description:
Stalls of striped canvas crowd the top of the market square, their
awnings snapping in the breeze and their keepers crying prices over one
another. North, the square narrows toward the Temple Fountain, where the
dome of the Temple rises white above the rooftops. The cobbles slope
gently south into the middle of the square, while Inn Street opens east
under a row of hanging signs. West, Alchemy Street slips away between
tall houses that smell faintly of sulphur.

203007.name: The Bar Of The Gryphon's Rest Inn

east.description: To the east lies The Reception.

south.description: To the south lies Inn Street.

203007.description:
Low beams blackened by pipe smoke hang over the bar of the Gryphon's
Rest Inn, and a long oak counter, ringed by years of tankards, runs the
length of the room. A painted gryphon spreads its wings across the wall
behind the casks, its gilt flaking in places. Tables and settles crowd
close around a fire that is never quite allowed to die. A door east
leads through to the reception, and the way south returns to Inn Street.

extra_descs.gryphon painting wall:
The gryphon is painted rampant in gold and russet, its beak open in a
silent cry. Someone long ago added a tankard to one of its claws in a
clumsier hand, and no landlord since has had the heart to paint it out.

3008.name: The Reception
3008.description:
This is the reception. The staircase leads down to the entrance hall. An
exit to the north leads to the Cryogenic Center. There is a small sign
on the counter. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. Shadows
gather in the corners.

south.description: To the south lies Inn Street.

west.description: To the west lies The Bar Of The Gryphon's Rest Inn.

3009.name: The Bakery

extra_descs.baker: Flour has settled into every line of the baker's face. He works the dough like a man who has outlasted three wars and intends to outlast the next.
extra_descs.shelves loaves bread: Crusty rounds, honey twists, and a row of hard travel loaves that the baker swears will survive anything short of dragonfire.

3009.description: The warm smell of fresh bread fills this cozy bakery. Shelves line the walls, loaded with loaves, rolls, and pastries. A flour-dusted baker works behind the counter, kneading dough with practiced hands.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Main Street

3010.name: The General Store
3010.description:
This isside the general store. All sorts of items are stacked on shelves
behind the counter, safely out of your reach. A small note hangs on the
wall. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The walls are rough-hewn and cold
to the touch.
A sturdy workbench with leatherworking tools occupies the back.

south.description: You see the main street.

3011.name: The Weapon Shop
3011.description:
This isside the weapon shop. There is a small note on the counter. The
air is still and musty. Shadows gather in the corners. The air is stale
and the walls close. Shadows pool in the corners, undisturbed.
A massive dwarven forge dominates one corner, its coals glowing hot.

west.description: To the west lies Gallows Square.

3012.name: Main Street

extra_descs.street: Cart ruts run deep in the cobbles here, all bending toward the market square like streams toward a river.

3012.description:
This is the end of the main street of Garathorm. South of here is the
entrance to the Guild of Magic Users. The street continues east towards
the market square. The magic shop is to the north and to the west is the
city gate. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet. Vendors
and pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: To the north lies Alchemy Street.

east.description: You see the main street.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Alley.

west.description: You see the city gate.

3013.name: Main Street
3013.description:
The area is the main street passing through the City of Garathorm. South
of here is the entrance to the Armory, and the bakery is to the north.
East of here is the market square. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.
The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: You see the bakery.

east.description: You see the market square.

south.description: You see the armory.

west.description: You see the main street.

3014.name: The Middle Of Market Square

extra_descs.statue: The statue depicts a hero nobody can name, sword raised toward the east gate. Pigeons have crowned him; he bears it with stone dignity.
extra_descs.square: By dawn the square belongs to farmers, by noon to merchants, by midnight to thieves. Everyone agrees this is fair.

3014.description:
This area is the market square, the famous Square of Garathorm. A large,
peculiar looking statue is standing in the middle of the square. Roads
lead in every direction, north to the temple square, south to the common
square, east and westbound is the main street. A grand marble building
to the west bears the sign 'First National Bank'. A small stone
fountain bubbles cheerfully near the statue. The statue's base hums
faintly, runes flickering when no one looks directly at them. The smell
of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. Vendors and pedestrians bustle
past.
A sturdy oak counter stands near the statue where Guildmaster Harlan
conducts the Auction House, calling out prices and finalizing deals.

north.description: To the north lies Northern End Of Market Square.

east.description: You see the main street.

south.description: You see the common square.

3015.name: The Main Street
3015.description:
The area is the main street crossing through town. To the north is the
general store, and the main street continues east. To the west you see
and hear the market place, to the south a small door leads into the Pet
Shop. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. Buildings crowd together on
all sides.

north.description: You see the general store.

east.description: You see the main street.

south.description: You see the Pet Shop.

west.description: You see the market square.

3016.name: The Main Street
3016.description:
The main street, to the north is the weapon shop and to the south is the
Guild of Swordsmen. To the east you leave town and to the west the
street leads to the market square. Buildings crowd together on all
sides. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: To the north lies Inn Street.

east.description: You see the city gate.

south.description: To the south lies Gallows Square.

west.description: You see the main street leading to the market square.

3017.name: Entrance to the Mages' Guild
3017.description:
The entrance hall to this guild is a small, poor lighted room. The air
is still and musty. Shadows gather in the corners. The air is stale and
the walls close. Shadows pool in the corners, undisturbed.
A glowing enchanting circle is inscribed on the floor.

east.description: To the east lies Alchemy Street.

south.description: You see your favorite place, the Mages' Bar.

3018.name: Mages' Bar
3018.description:
The bar is one of the weirdest in the land. Mystical images float around
the air. Illusions of fine furniture appear all around the room. The
walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. The air is still and musty.

north.description: You see the lobby.

west.description: To the west lies Mages' Laboratory.

3019.name: Mages' Laboratory

extra_descs.tables pipes flasks: One flask bubbles by itself, unattended, and has been - according to a yellowing warning note - since the year 987.
extra_descs.floor: Scorch marks on the flagstones form rough circles, each one ringed with chalk annotations in a nervous hand.

3019.description:
This is the Magical Experiments Laboratory. Dark smoke-stained stones
arch over numerous huge oaken tables, most of these cluttered with
strange- looking pipes and flasks. The floor is covered with half-erased
pentagrams and even weirder symbols, and a blackboard in a dark corner
has only been partially cleaned, some painful-looking letters faintly
visible. A well in the middle of the floor leads down into darkness.
Vile smells waft from the depths. Shadows gather in the corners. The
walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

east.description: To the east lies Mages' Bar.

3020.name: The Armoury
3020.description:
The armory with all kinds of armors on the walls and in the window. You
see helmets, shields and chain mails. To the north is the main street.
On the wall is a small note. The ceiling hangs low overhead. Dust motes
drift in the stale air.
A well-maintained forge stands ready for use.

north.description: You see the main street.

3021.name: Entrance to the Warriors' Guild
3021.description:
The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen. A place where one has to be
careful not to say something wrong (or right). To the east is the bar
and to the north is the main street. Dust motes drift in the stale air.
The ceiling hangs low overhead.

north.description: To the north lies Gallows Square.

east.description: You see the swordsmen's bar, many noises comes from there.

3022.name: The Bar Of Swordsmen
3022.description:
The bar of swordsmen, once upon a time beautifully furnished. But now
the furniture is all around in small pieces. To the south is the
yard, and to the west is the entrance hall. Shadows gather in the
corners. The air is still and musty.

south.description: You see the practice yard.

west.description: You see the entrance hall to the warriors' guild.

3023.name: The Tournament And Practice Yard

extra_descs.well: A practice sword lies bent at the well's lip. The fighters say you can hear it splash if you drop a coin; nobody has heard the coin land.
extra_descs.dummies yard: The straw dummies have been stabbed, burned, frozen and once, memorably, married. The guild does not discuss the incident.

3023.description:
This is the practice yard of the fighters. To the north is the bar. A
well leads down into darkness. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the
touch. The air is still and musty.

north.description: You see the bar.

3045.name: The Dark Alley
3045.description:
This is the alley which continues east and west. South of here you see
the levee. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet. The smell
of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: To the north lies Main Street.

east.description: The alley leads east.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Alley.

west.description: To the west lies The Silver Goblet Tavern.

3025.name: Southern End Of Market Square

extra_descs.people square: Gossip moves through the common square faster than the wind: who's hiring, who's missing, what crawled out of the sewers last night.

3025.description:
The common square, people pass you, talking to each other. To the west
is the poor alley and to the east is the dark alley. To the north, this
square is connected to the market square. From the south you notice a
nasty smell. The cobblestones near the old well look loose. The smell of
smoke and humanity hangs in the air. Vendors and pedestrians bustle
past.

north.description: You see the market square.

east.description: You see the dark alley.

south.description: To the south lies Harbour Square.

west.description: To the west lies Eastern End Of Dark Alley.

203026.name: Harbour Square

north.description: To the north lies Southern End Of Market Square.

east.description: To the east lies The Japanese Garden.

south.description: To the south lies The Quay.

west.description: To the west lies The Statue Base Cache.

203026.description:
Harbour Square smells of tar, river water and fish, and gulls wheel and
cry over the slate roofs. A weathered bronze statue of a sea captain
stands on a broad plinth at the west side of the square, a small dark
opening half hidden at its base. North, the cobbles climb toward the
Southern End Of Market Square, and east a whitewashed wall encloses the
Japanese Garden. South, the square runs down to the stone edge of the
Quay.

3027.name: Entrance to the Thieves' Guild
3027.description:
The entrance hall to the thieves' and assassins' guild. A place where
you can lose both your life and your money, if you are not careful. To
the north is the dark alley and to the east is the thieves' bar. Shadows
gather in the corners. The air is still and musty.

east.description: You see the thieves bar, where everything disappears.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark Alley.

3028.name: The Thieves' Bar
3028.description:
The bar of the thieves. Once upon a time this place was beautifully
furnished, but now it seems almost empty. To the south is the yard, and
to the west is the entrance hall. (Maybe the furniture has been
stolen?!) Dust motes drift in the stale air. The air is still and musty.

south.description: You see the secret yard.

west.description: You see the entrance hall to the thieves' guild.

3029.name: The Secret Yard

extra_descs.well: Scratched beside the well mouth, in thieves' cant: 'fastest way down. second fastest way up.'

3029.description:
The secret practice yard of thieves and assassins. To the north is the
bar. A well leads down into darkness. The air is still and musty. The
walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

north.description: You see the bar.

south.description: To the south lies The Path Along The River.

3030.name: The Dump

extra_descs.garbage pipes junction: The pipe junction yawns out of the refuse like a mouth. Warm air sighs from it, smelling of the city's secrets gone soft.
extra_descs.dump: Gulls, rats and one philosophical old man pick through the heaps. All three find treasure more often than you'd think.

3030.description:
The dump, where the people from the city drop their garbage. Through the
garbage Visible is a large junction of pipes, looks like the entrance to
the sewer system. North of here you see the common square. The open sky
stretches overhead. The air is fresh and clean.

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Alley.

east.description: To the east lies The Path Along The River.

west.description: To the west lies Wall Road.

3031.name: The Pet Shop
3031.description:
The Pet Shop is a small crowded store, full of cages and animals of
various sizes. There is a sign on the wall. The walls are rough-hewn and
cold to the touch. The air is still and musty.

north.description: You see the main street.

3033.name: The Magic Shop

extra_descs.racks items: Wands sorted by temperament, potions by color, and one shelf labeled simply 'DO NOT' in three alphabets.

3033.description:
Behind the counter you see various items, neatly placed in racks,
presumably most of them are magic. The air is still and musty. Dust
motes drift in the stale air.
An alchemy table covered in vials and burners sits against the wall.

south.description: To the south lies Alchemy Street.

3034.name: Alchemy Street

north.description: To the north lies The Magic Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Alchemy Street.

south.description: To the south lies Main Street.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance to the Mages' Guild.

3034.description:
Strange smells hang over this end of Alchemy Street, sulphur and burnt
sugar and something sharp that stings the nose. North, a bow window
crowded with glass bottles and coloured flames marks the magic shop, and
west a doorway carved with runes opens into the entrance to the Mages'
Guild. The street runs on east between leaning houses, and south it
turns into Main Street. The gutters here run faintly blue and green with
spilled reagents.

3035.name: Alchemy Street

north.description: To the north lies The Garathorm Auction Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Northern End Of Market Square.

south.description: To the south lies The Bank.

west.description: To the west lies Alchemy Street.

3035.description:
Alchemy Street widens here between two of the most solid buildings in
Garathorm. North stands the Garathorm Auction Hall, its doors hung with
notices of lots to be sold, and south the Bank squats behind iron-barred
windows and a door of studded oak. East, the street spills out into the
bustle of the market square. West, it narrows among the alchemists'
shops, where little coloured puffs of smoke rise from crooked chimneys.

3036.name: Inn Street

north.description: To the north lies The Bar Of The Gryphon's Rest Inn.

east.description: To the east lies Inn Street.

south.description: To the south lies The Post Office.

west.description: To the west lies Northern End Of Market Square.

3036.description:
Inn Street runs here beneath a long timber roof, a covered way built so
that travellers could reach their beds dry in the worst of the rain.
Lanterns hang from the rafters on chains, throwing warm light over
flagstones scuffed by boots and barrel-rims. A carved gryphon over a
doorway to the north marks the bar of the Gryphon's Rest Inn, and the
post office stands south behind a counter window stacked with parcels.
The covered way continues east, and west it opens onto the market
square.

3037.name: Inn Street

north.description: To the north lies The Reception.

east.description: To the east lies The Cityguards' Barracks.

south.description: To the south lies The Main Street.

west.description: To the west lies Inn Street.

3037.description:
The covered length of Inn Street ends here at a broad crossing of
passages under a roof of smoke-stained planks. A small arched doorway
north climbs a few steps to the reception, where a bell can be heard
ringing now and then. East, a heavy iron-banded door bears the city's
crest and opens into the cityguards' barracks. South, the passage opens
out toward The Main Street, and west the lantern-lit way runs back along
the inns.

3038.name: The Cityguards' Barracks

north.description: To the north lies The Combat Practice Yard.

west.description: To the west lies Inn Street.

east.description: To the east lies Ye Olde Water Shoppe.

3038.description:
Rows of narrow cots, each with a footlocker at its end, line the
whitewashed walls of the cityguards' barracks. Halberds and round
shields hang in racks by the door, polished and ready, and a duty roster
is chalked on a board beside them. A doorway north lets in the clatter
of the combat practice yard, and through a side door east drifts the
damp, clean smell of Ye Olde Water Shoppe. The iron-banded door west
leads back out to Inn Street.

3039.name: The Path Along The River

east.description: To the east lies The Quay.

west.description: To the west lies The Dump.

3039.description:
A narrow path of trodden earth and broken cobbles runs along the river's
edge here, between the water and the backs of tumbledown sheds. Reeds
grow thick on the bank, and the slow brown river slides past carrying
leaves and the odd bit of driftwood. East, the path firms into the stone
of the Quay, while west a sour reek drifts up from the Dump. Overhead
the sky is wide and open, smudged with chimney smoke.

3040.name: Inside the West Gate of Garathorm

extra_descs.towers footbridge gate: Guards on the footbridge track everything that passes below. The western tower's bell has rung true for a century; the eastern one sticks in wet weather.

3040.description:
The area is by two small towers that have been built into the city wall
and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. Main
Street leads east and Wall Road leads south from here. High above, a
shadowed ledge looks like it could hide a watch post. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the
air.

north.description: To the north lies Academy Path.

east.description: You see Main Street.

south.description: You see the road running along the inner side of the city wall.  You notice that it is called Wall Road.

west.description: To the west lies Trade Road.

up.description: To the up lies On The City Wall.

3041.name: The Gate To The Inner City

extra_descs.towers footbridge gate: The east gate's timbers are scarred at axe height. The carpenters stopped sanding the marks out; they make a better warning than any sign.

3041.description:
The area is by two small towers that have been built into the city wall
and connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. Main
Street leads west from here. To the south you see the Water Shop. The
sounds of city life echo around. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.

east.description: To the east lies Trade Road.

west.description: You see Main Street.

up.description: To the up lies On The City Wall.

north.description: To the north lies Pet Shop Store.

3042.name: Wall Road
3042.description:
The way continues next to the western city wall. The road continues
further south and the city gate is just north of here. The smell of
smoke and humanity hangs in the air. The cobblestones are worn smooth by
countless feet.

north.description: You see the city gate.

east.description: To the east lies The Undertaker's Workshop.

south.description: The road continues further south.

west.description: To the west lies The Old Watch Post.

3043.name: Wall Road
3043.description:
The way continues next to the western city wall. Wall Road continues
further north and south. A small, poor alley leads east. Some letters
have been written on the wall here. The cobblestones are worn smooth by
countless feet. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: The road continues further north.

east.description: Poor Alley leads east.

south.description: The road continues further south.

3044.name: The Dark Alley
3044.description:
The area is Poor Alley, which continues further east. You see the city
wall to the west. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Alley.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance to the Thieves' Guild.

south.description: To the south lies The Dump.

west.description: The alley leads west.

up.description: To the up lies The Arena Center.

203045.name: The Quay

north.description: To the north lies Harbour Square.

east.description: To the east lies The Quay.

south.description: To the south lies On The Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies The Path Along The River.

203045.description:
Great blocks of grey stone form the edge of the Quay, iron rings set
into them for mooring and their faces green with weed where the river
laps. Bollards, coiled hawsers and tarred posts clutter the wharf.
Harbour Square lies north up a short slope, and the Quay runs on east
along the water. South, the stone arch of a bridge leaps the river, and
west a muddy path follows the bank away from the city.

3046.name: Eastern End Of Dark Alley
3046.description:
The area opens at the eastern end of the alley, the city wall is just
east, blocking any further movement. A small warehouse is directly south
of here. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: To the north lies Uncle Juan's Eatery.

east.description: To the east lies Southern End Of Market Square.

south.description: You see the warehouse.

west.description: You see the alley.

3047.name: Wall Road
3047.description:
This area is the road next to the western city wall, which continues
north. South of here is a bridge across the river. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past. The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: You see the road.

east.description: To the east lies The Dump.

south.description: You see the bridge.

203048.name: The Silver Goblet Tavern

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Alley.

203048.description:
The Silver Goblet Tavern is a low-beamed taproom, dim and close, with a
sagging ceiling stained brown by pipe smoke and a fire smouldering in a
wide hearth. Battered tables and benches crowd the sawdust floor, and a
dented silver goblet, the tavern's namesake, hangs on a chain above the
bar. Quiet corners with high-backed settles suit those who would rather
not be seen. The door leads east out into The Dark Alley.

extra_descs.silver goblet chain:
The goblet is tarnished nearly black and dented on one side, as if it
once stopped a blow. Its chain is fixed fast to a beam above the bar.

3049.name: The Quay

north.description: To the north lies The Warehouse.

south.description: You see the river flowing west.

west.description: To the west lies The Quay.

east.description: To the east lies The Forgotten Passage.

3049.description:
The far end of the Quay is quieter, its stones cracked and its bollards
leaning. Wooden steps lead down from the edge of the wharf to the water
south, where small boats can put out onto the river. A tall timber
warehouse stands north, its loading doors and hoist beam looming over
the stones. East, half hidden by a heap of rotting nets, a low dark
opening in the old wall leads into a forgotten passage, and west the
Quay runs back toward the bridge.

203050.name: The Warehouse

south.description: To the south lies The Quay.

203050.description:
Stacks of crates, bales and casks rise almost to the rafters of this
great draughty warehouse, each marked in chalk with a merchant's sign.
Narrow aisles run between them, and the air smells of tar, hemp and
river damp. A hoist rope hangs from a beam above the wide doors to the
south, which open onto the Quay. Pale light seeps in through gaps in the
plank walls.

3051.name: On the Bridge

extra_descs.bridge river opening: Ten feet below, the river hurries through its archway in the wall. Lovers' padlocks rust along the bridge rail, keys somewhere in the silt.

3051.description:
This area is the stone bridge crosses the river. The bridge is built out
from the western city wall and the river flows west through an opening
in the wall ten feet below the bridge. Buildings crowd together on all
sides. The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: You see the road.

south.description: You see the Concourse.

east.description: To the east lies Housing District - Main Street.

3054.name: By The Temple Altar

extra_descs.ven though the altar is more than ten fe: a single block of white virgin marble.
extra_descs.statue odin: Odin's stone gaze has watched over every soul ever raised at this altar. One eye is carved shut; the sculptor knew the stories.

3054.description:
The area is by the temple altar in the northern end of the Temple of
Garathorm. A huge altar made from white polished marble is standing ahead
and behind it is a ten foot tall sitting statue of Odin, the King of the
Gods. To the north, steps lead out the back of the temple towards the
countryside. Shadows gather in the corners. The walls are rough-hewn and
cold to the touch.

west.description: To the west lies The Temple Of Garathorm.

3056.name: Uncle Juan's Eatery

south.description: To the south lies Eastern End Of Dark Alley.

3056.description:
Mismatched tables and chairs fill Uncle Juan's Eatery, a cramped little
room whose walls are hung with strings of dried peppers and garlic. A
great iron pot simmers on the hearth at the back, filling the air with
the smell of beans, onions and spice. A slate by the counter lists the
day's dishes in chalk, most of them cheap and all of them filling. The
door south opens onto the Eastern End Of Dark Alley.

3057.name: The Japanese Garden

north.description: To the north lies Council Avenue.

west.description: To the west lies Harbour Square.

south.description: To the south lies The Eastern End Of Poor Alley.

3057.description:
Raked gravel flows in careful ripples around mossy stones in this quiet
walled garden, a gift, the gardeners say, from travellers who came from
beyond the far sea. A little red bridge arches over a pond where lily
pads drift, and a stone lantern stands by the water's edge. Through the
moon gate north lies Council Avenue, and a plain wooden gate south lets
out into the Eastern End Of Poor Alley. Harbour Square opens to the west
past a stand of maples.

extra_descs.stone lantern:
The lantern is a squat pagoda of grey granite, its little roof furred
with moss. A candle is lit inside it each evening, and its light
trembles on the pond.

3050.name: The Water Shop
3050.description:
This isside the warehouse. The room is decorated with various old items
from ships. Shadows gather in the corners. The air is still and musty.

north.description: You see the alley.

203059.name: The Gate Of The Inner City

north.description: To the north lies Trade Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Temple Of Garathorm.

up.description: To the up lies On The City Wall.

west.description: To the west lies The Training Grounds.

203059.description:
The Gate Of The Inner City stands open in a deep arch of pale stone, its
iron-shod leaves folded back against walls blackened by centuries of
torch smoke. North through the arch, the Trade Road runs off between
merchants' houses toward the wider realm. South, broad marble steps
climb to the Temple of Garathorm, whose great dome fills the sky above
the gate. A packed-earth yard opens west onto the training grounds, and
a narrow stair in the gate tower climbs up to the wall-walk.

3062.name: The Post Office

extra_descs.nvelopes of all sizes are heaped into hu: look closer, you see a letter that you had posted a full week ago, laying unnoticed and slightly rat-chewed towards the bottom of the pile.
extra_descs.mail crates piles: One crate is addressed, in beautiful copperplate, to 'The Hero Who Will Eventually Open This.' The customs seal is unbroken.

3062.description:
This is the central post office for Garathorm. Piles of assorted mail lay
untouched in the corners, collecting cobwebs. Several large crates have
been pried open by curious customs agents, and are now stacked along the
west wall, hiding plenty of 'WANTED' posters. There is a sign posted on
the wall here. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. The
sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: To the north lies Inn Street.

3063.name: The Garathorm Donation Room
3063.description:
This is a small, undecorated room just off of the main temple. There are
a couple of small wooden benches here where people occasionally sit
while they wait for items to appear. The temple is to the west. Vendors
and pedestrians bustle past. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

west.description: To the west lies The Temple Fountain.

203065.name: The Garathorm Auction Hall

south.description: To the south lies Alchemy Street.

203065.description:
Rows of wooden benches face a raised platform in this echoing hall,
where an auctioneer's lectern stands beside a heavy gavel block worn
hollow in the middle. Chalk boards along the walls list lots, reserves
and closing bids in a crabbed hand, many crossed out and written over.
High windows let dusty shafts of daylight fall across the floorboards.
The doors south lead back out onto Alchemy Street.

203066.name: The Combat Practice Yard

east.description: To the east lies The Dummy Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Cityguards' Barracks.

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance Hall Of The Grunting Boar Inn.

203066.description:
This walled yard of beaten earth is scored with the circles and lines of
a hundred drills, and the ground is churned soft where boots have
pivoted and lunged. Wooden pells stand along one side, hacked pale by
blade after blade, and a water trough sits by the wall for the thirsty.
North, a back door opens into the entrance hall of the Grunting Boar
Inn, while a low shed east houses the dummy room. The barracks lie
south, through a plain doorway under the open sky.

3067.name: Gallows Square

north.description: To the north lies The Main Street.

east.description: To the east lies The Weapon Shop.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance to the Warriors' Guild.

west.description: To the west lies Council Avenue.

3067.description:
An old gallows of weathered black timber stands on a stone platform in
the middle of this square, unused for years but never taken down.
Pigeons line its crossbeam, and the cobbles beneath it are stained
darker than the rest. The Main Street lies north, and the ring of hammer
on steel carries from the weapon shop east. South, a stout door opens
into the entrance to the Warriors' Guild, while Council Avenue leads
west.

extra_descs.gallows platform:
The gallows has not been used in living memory. Its rope is long gone,
and the iron hook on the crossbeam has rusted to a dull brown stump.

3026.name: Council Avenue

north.description: To the north lies The Council Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies Gallows Square.

south.description: To the south lies The Japanese Garden.

west.description: You see the common square.

3026.description:
Council Avenue is the grandest street in this part of Garathorm, its
cobbles laid in neat fans and its gutters swept clean each dawn. Banners
of the city hang from tall poles along the way, stirring in the wind off
the rooftops. North rise the columned steps of the Council Chamber, and
south a moon gate in a whitewashed wall opens onto the Japanese Garden.
East lies Gallows Square, and west the avenue runs down to the busy
Southern End Of Market Square.

203069.name: The Council Chamber

south.description: To the south lies Council Avenue.

up.description: To the up lies The Marble Tower Of Garathorm.

203069.description:
Tiers of carved benches rise in a half-ring around a long table of dark
walnut in the Council Chamber, where Garathorm's councillors meet to
quarrel over the city's affairs. Tall windows of leaded glass let in a
pale, even light, and the city's arms are worked in coloured stone upon
the floor. A spiral stair behind the dais climbs up into the Marble
Tower. The great doors south open onto Council Avenue.

203074.name: On The Bridge

north.description: To the north lies The Quay.

south.description: To the south lies The Promenade.

203074.description:
The stone bridge arches high over the river here, its parapet worn
smooth by the hands of countless leaning idlers. Below, the brown water
swirls around the piers and carries the city's reflections away
downstream. North, the bridge comes down onto the Quay among the
warehouses, and south it descends to the Promenade on the far bank. Wind
off the water tugs at cloaks and carries the cries of gulls.

203075.name: The Gate Of The Inner City

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies Trade Road.

up.description: To the up lies On The City Wall.

203075.description:
The Gate Of The Inner City opens here through the thickness of the wall,
a deep arch of grey stone with a portcullis hanging raised above, its
iron teeth rusted brown. Two round towers flank the passage and banners
of Garathorm stir high on their parapets. A narrow stair climbs up
inside the tower to the walk along the city wall. The Concourse lies
north within the walls, and the Trade Road runs out south into open
country.

extra_descs.portcullis iron teeth:
The portcullis is a lattice of oak beams shod in iron, its lower edge
ending in a row of rusted spikes. Its chains run up into slots in the
arch, and it has not been lowered in living memory.

203076.name: The Undertaker's Workshop

west.description: To the west lies Wall Road.

203076.description:
The Undertaker's Workshop is a long, cool room smelling of sawdust,
pitch and dried herbs. Coffins in every stage of making lean against the
walls, from bare planks to finished caskets lined with black cloth, and
a heavy workbench stands under a window of thick, greenish glass. A lamp
burns low before a small shrine set in an alcove of the far wall. The
door opens west onto Wall Road, in the shadow of the city wall.

203077.name: The Bank

north.description: To the north lies Alchemy Street.

203077.description:
Behind a long counter of polished marble, brass grilles divide the
clerks' windows of the Bank from the public floor. The room is hushed,
its stone walls thick and cool, and every footstep rings on the tiled
floor. A great iron vault door, set with three locks and a wheel, fills
the back wall behind the counter. The only way out is north, through the
studded doors to Alchemy Street.

extra_descs.vault door iron:
The vault door is as tall as two men and blackened with age. Its three
locks each take a different key, and the great wheel at its centre is
polished bright by the clerks' hands.

203078.name: The Marble Tower Of Garathorm

down.description: To the down lies The Council Chamber.

203078.description:
Polished white marble rises on every side in this high round room at the
top of the Marble Tower Of Garathorm. Narrow windows set at intervals in
the curving wall frame the rooftops, the city wall and the white dome of
the Temple far below. A brass telescope on a stand points out through
one of them, and a ring of cushioned benches follows the line of the
room. The spiral stair winds back down to the Council Chamber.

3079.name: The Cartographer's Study

south.description: To the south lies The Map Room.

3079.description:
The Cartographer's Study is a cramped, cluttered room where a slanting
drafting desk stands beneath a lamp with a polished reflector. Rolled
charts are stacked in pigeonholes along the walls, and the desk's
surface is scarred with compass pricks and splashed with ink. An
unfinished map of some far coast is pinned to the desk, its edges still
blank. The only door leads south to the Map Room.

3070.name: The Map Room

extra_descs.relief table map clay:
The clay relief shows the whole of the known realm, from the walls of
Garathorm to the Sea of Storms. Some regions at its edges are left
unpainted and blank.

north.description: To the north lies The Cartographer's Study.

south.description: The bookshelf passage leads back south.

west.description: To the west lies The Keymaster's Workshop.

3070.description:
Maps cover every wall of this square chamber, painted and pinned and
pasted one over another until the plaster vanishes beneath coastlines,
rivers and roads. A great table in the centre bears a relief of
Misthollow modelled in painted clay, its mountains and forests raised in
miniature. A door north opens on the Cartographer's Study, a low arch
west leads into the Keymaster's Workshop, and the library lies south.
Brass lamps hang low over the table.

203081.name: The Hall of Champions

north.description: To the north lies The Temple Library.

up.description: To the up lies The Tower of Champions.

203081.description:
The Hall of Champions is a lofty chamber of white marble where the names
of the realm's great heroes are carved in gilded letters on tall tablets
along the walls. Banners of past deeds hang tattered from the gallery
rails, and a ring of empty plinths awaits statues not yet raised. A
spiral stair climbs up into the Tower of Champions, and the library lies
back north through a high arch. Candles burn steadily in iron stands.

extra_descs.tablets names heroes:
The tablets are cut from pale marble, each name picked out in gold leaf.
Many tablets stand still smooth and empty, waiting for names yet to be
earned.

203082.name: The Keymaster's Workshop

east.description: To the east lies The Map Room.

203082.description:
The Keymaster's Workshop is a narrow room smelling of oil and iron
filings, its walls hung with board after board of hooks where countless
keys once hung, many now bare. A small anvil and a vice are fixed to a
sturdy bench beneath a lamp, and a rack of fine files stands beside
them. Locks of every size, taken apart, are mounted on the wall like
trophies. The doorway leads east back to the Map Room.

203083.name: The Tower of Champions

down.description: To the down lies The Hall of Champions.

203083.description:
The Tower of Champions is a round room at the top of a spiral stair, its
walls pierced by tall arched windows that look out over the rooftops of
Garathorm to the hills beyond. Shields of fallen heroes are hung about
the walls, each painted with its bearer's arms. A brazier on a bronze
tripod burns in the centre of the floor. The stair winds down to the
Hall of Champions.

3084.name: The Dummy Room

west.description: To the west lies The Combat Practice Yard.

3084.description:
Straw-stuffed dummies hang from hooks along the beams of this long, low
shed, swaying slightly whenever the door is opened. Most have been
beaten and restitched so many times that their sacking is more patch
than cloth. Sawdust covers the floorboards to soak up sweat, and a
single lantern burns behind a wire cage by the door. The only way out is
west, back into the combat practice yard.

3100.name: Northwest End Of The Concourse
3100.description:
This is the concourse, the city wall is just west. A small promenade
goes east, and the bridge is just north of here. The concourse continues
south along the city wall. The sounds of city life echo around.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: You see the Bridge.

east.description: You see the promenade.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3101.name: The Promenade
3101.description:
The river gently flows westwards just north of here. The promenade
continues further east and to the west you see the city wall. Park Road
leads south from here. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. The smell of
smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

east.description: The promenade continues.

south.description: Park Road leads south.

west.description: You see the Concourse.

3102.name: The Promenade
3102.description:
The river gently flows westwards just north of here. The promenade
continues both east and west. South of here you see the entrance to the
park, and a small building seems to be just west of the entrance. The
smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. The cobblestones are worn
smooth by countless feet.

east.description: You see the promenade.

south.description: You see the park entrance.

west.description: You see the promenade.

3103.name: The Promenade
3103.description:
The river gently flows westwards just north of here. The promenade
continues both east and west. A small path leads south. Looking across
the river you see the levee. The cobblestones are worn smooth by
countless feet. The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: To the north lies On The Bridge.

east.description: You see the Concourse.

south.description: The small path leads south.

west.description: You see the promenade.

3104.name: Northeast End Of The Concourse
3104.description:
This is the Concourse. The city wall is just east and a small promenade
goes west. Looking across the river you see a building that resembles a
warehouse. The Concourse continues south along the city wall. The smell
of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. Vendors and pedestrians bustle
past.

east.description: To the east lies On The Concourse.

west.description: You see the promenade.

3105.name: Park Entrance
3105.description:
The area opens just inside the small park of Garathorm. To the north is
the promenade and a small path leads south into the park. to the east is
the famous Park Cafe. The sounds of city life echo around. The
cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet.

north.description: You see the promenade.

east.description: You see Park Cafe.

south.description: You see the park.

3106.name: Park Cafe
3106.description:
This isside Park Cafe, a very cozy place with many tables and seats
where you can relax and enjoy the view. To the east Visible is the
entrance to the park. The air is still and musty. Shadows gather in the
corners.

west.description: You see the park entrance.

3107.name: A Small Path Through The Park
3107.description:
A path winds along a small path through the park. The path continues
south and east. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to A Small Path In The Park

south.description: The cobblestones lead to A Path In The Park

3108.name: A Small Path In The Park
3108.description:
This area is a small path inside the park. The park entrance is just
north of here, and Park Cafe is just east of the entrance. The path
leads further east and west. Buildings crowd together on all sides. The
cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet.

north.description: You see the northern park entrance.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to A Small Path In The Park

west.description: The cobblestones lead to A Small Path In The Park

3109.name: A Small Path In The Park
3109.description:
The area is a small path running through the park. It continues west and
south and just north of here you see the southern wall of Park Cafe. The
sounds of city life echo around. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to A Path In The Park

west.description: The cobblestones lead to A Small Path In The Park

3110.name: Cityguard Headquarters
3110.description:
The cityguard headquarters buzzes with activity. Stone walls are lined
with weapon racks and duty rosters. Guards in polished armor stand
ready, while others study maps of patrol routes. The walls are rough-
hewn and cold to the touch. Dust motes drift in the stale air.

east.description: You see Park Road.

3111.name: Park Road
3111.description:
The road continues north and south. A building is just west of here, you
notice a sign on the door. The park entrance is to the east. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past. The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

west.description: You see the Cityguard HeadQuarters.

203112.name: Park Road

north.description: To the north lies Park Road.

south.description: To the south lies Park Road.

203112.description:
Park Road runs straight here between low garden walls overhung with ivy
and the branches of old fruit trees grown up behind them. The cobbles
are uneven where roots have heaved them, and a stone drinking fountain
set in the wall dribbles into a mossy basin. The road goes on north
toward a bend and south toward the crossing with Elm Street. The scent
of cut grass drifts over the walls.

3113.name: A Path In The Park
3113.description:
This is the park. The paths lead north and west. Westward is the park
entrance and to the east you see a small pond. Vendors and pedestrians
bustle past. The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to A Small Path In The Park

east.description: You see the pond.

3114.name: The Pond
3114.description:
The area is swimming around in the pond, feeling rather stupid. You can
get back on the path from the eastern and western end of the pond.
Ripples spread across the surface. The current tugs gently at your
limbs.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to A Path In The Park

west.description: The cobblestones lead to A Path In The Park

3115.name: A Path In The Park
3115.description:
This is the park. The paths lead north and east. Eastward is the park
entrance and to the west you see a small pond. The smell of smoke and
humanity hangs in the air. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to A Small Path In The Park

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Eastern Park Entrance

west.description: The water flows toward The Pond

3116.name: Eastern Park Entrance
3116.description:
The area opens at the eastern end of the park. A small path leads west
into the park. Going east through the entrance you will reach Emerald
Avenue. The sounds of city life echo around. Buildings crowd together on
all sides.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

west.description: The cobblestones lead to A Path In The Park

3117.name: Emerald Avenue
3117.description:
This area is the north end of Emerald Avenue. To the north is the
promenade and to the west is the park entrance. To the east is the not
very big Town Hall of Garathorm. The cobblestones are worn smooth by
countless feet. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

east.description: A passage leads to The Waiting Room

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Eastern Park Entrance

3118.name: Park Road
3118.description:
Cobblestones give way to smooth flagstones along this well-maintained
park road. Ancient oak trees provide shade overhead, and the scent of
flowers drifts from nearby gardens. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

3119.name: Emerald Avenue
3119.description:
The area opens at a bend on Emerald Avenue. The road leads north and
west. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet. Buildings
crowd together on all sides.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

south.description: To the south lies Emerald Avenue.

3120.name: Road Crossing

South - Emerald Avenue.    West  - Park Road.  Someone has added the following with red paint:     Up    - Redferne's Flying Citadel.

3120.description:
This is the middle of the road cross. Roads lead in all directions. A
huge black iron chain as thick as a tree trunk is fastened into the
ground at the center of the road cross. Its other end leads directly
upwards towards the sky. A road sign is here. The sounds of city life
echo around. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

east.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

up.description: To the up lies On The Huge Chain.

3121.name: Emerald Avenue
3121.description:
The area opens at a bend on Emerald Avenue. The road leads south and
east. The sounds of city life echo around. The smell of smoke and
humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: To the north lies Emerald Avenue.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

3122.name: Park Road
3122.description:
The area is Park Road which leads south and north. Elm Street is east of
here. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless feet. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: To the north lies Park Road.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to Elm Street

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

3123.name: Elm Street
3123.description:
The area is Elm street. Park Road is to the west and Elm Street
continues in eastward direction. The sounds of city life echo around.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

south.description: To the south lies End Of Elm Street.

west.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

3124.name: End Of Elm Street
3124.description:
Elm Street ends here at a weathered stone wall marking the city's
southern boundary. A single lantern flickers at the corner, casting long
shadows across the quiet residential district. The sounds of city life
echo around. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: To the north lies Elm Street.

up.description: To the up lies Up In The Elm Tree.

3125.name: Emerald Avenue
3125.description:
The area is Emerald Avenue which continues north. The Concourse is south
of here. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

south.description: The cobblestones lead to On The Concourse

3126.name: Park Road
3126.description:
The area is Park Road which continues north. The Concourse is south of
here. Buildings crowd together on all sides. The smell of smoke and
humanity hangs in the air.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

south.description: The cobblestones lead to On The Concourse

3127.name: On The Concourse
3127.description:
This is the southwest corner of the city wall. The Concourse leads both
north and east. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

east.description: To the east lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies Outside The Cathedral.

3128.name: On The Concourse
3128.description:
The Concourse continues both east and west. Emerald Avenue is north of
here. The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. The sounds of
city life echo around.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

east.description: The cobblestones lead to On The Concourse

south.description: To the south lies The Gate Of The Inner City.

west.description: To the west lies On The Concourse.

3129.name: On The Concourse
3129.description:
The Concourse continues both east and west. Park Road is north of here
and an iron grate leads south to the graveyard. Vendors and pedestrians
bustle past. The sounds of city life echo around.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

east.description: The cobblestones lead to On The Concourse

west.description: The cobblestones lead to On The Concourse

3130.name: On The Concourse
3130.description:
This is the southeast corner of the city wall. The Concourse leads both
north and west. The sounds of city life echo around. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past.

west.description: The cobblestones lead to On The Concourse

3131.name: Park Road
3131.description:
This is Park Road which continues north and south. The smell of smoke
and humanity hangs in the air. The cobblestones are worn smooth by
countless feet.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Promenade

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

3132.name: Emerald Avenue
3132.description:
This is Emerald Avenue which continues north and south. Penny Lane leads
east from here. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. The cobblestones
are worn smooth by countless feet.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Promenade

east.description: The cobblestones lead to Penny Lane

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

3133.name: Emerald Avenue
3133.description:
The area opens at a bend on Emerald Avenue. To the east the road goes on
and to the south is the Road Crossing. The cobblestones are worn smooth
by countless feet. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.

north.description: To the north lies Emerald Avenue.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to The Road Crossing

3134.name: Emerald Avenue
3134.description:
The area opens at a bend on Emerald Avenue. To the west the road goes on
and to the north is the Road Crossing. The cobblestones are worn smooth
by countless feet. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Road Crossing

south.description: To the south lies Emerald Avenue.

3135.name: Park Road
3135.description:
This is a bend on Park Road. To the north the road goes on and to the
east is the Road Crossing. The sounds of city life echo around.
Buildings crowd together on all sides.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to Park Road

west.description: To the west lies On The Concourse.

3136.name: Park Road
3136.description:
This is a bend on Park Road. To the south the road goes on and to the
west is the Road Crossing. The cobblestones are worn smooth by countless
feet. The sounds of city life echo around.

south.description: To the south lies Park Road.

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Road Crossing

3137.name: The Waiting Room
3137.description:
This is the waiting room at the town hall. Wooden chairs stand along the
walls and a long desk with a typewriter is placed in the middle of the
room. Shadows gather in the corners. Dust motes drift in the stale air.

east.description: It looks like some kind of office.

west.description: The exit west leads to Emerald Avenue.

3138.name: The Mayor's Office
3138.description:
This is the not very big office of the Mayor of Garathorm. A large and
polished but completely empty desk is standing in front of an armchair
that looks so comfortable that it most of all resembles a bed with the
head end raised slightly. Shadows gather in the corners. The walls are
rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

west.description: The waiting room is to the west.

3139.name: Penny Lane
3139.description:
The area is Penny Lane. Emerald Avenue is to the west and Penny Lane
continues in eastward direction. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past.
The smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to Penny Lane

west.description: The cobblestones lead to Emerald Avenue

3140.name: Penny Lane
3140.description:
The area is Penny Lane. The narrow road continues north and west.
Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. The cobblestones are worn smooth by
countless feet.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The End Of Penny Lane

west.description: The cobblestones lead to Penny Lane

3141.name: End Of Penny Lane
3141.description:
This is the end of Penny Lane. The only exit appears to be south. The
smell of smoke and humanity hangs in the air. The sounds of city life
echo around.

east.description: To the east lies Temple Entryway.

south.description: The cobblestones lead to Penny Lane

3142.name: Up In The Elm Tree

down.description: To the down lies End Of Elm Street.

3142.description:
High in the branches of a great elm, a broad fork makes a natural seat
where generations of city children have carved their initials into the
grey bark. Leaves rustle on every side and sunlight flickers through
them, and through gaps in the green you can see the rooftops and the
city wall beyond. The trunk is knobbed with old footholds that lead down
to the end of Elm Street below. The branches sway gently with the wind.

3143.name: On The Concourse

east.description: To the east lies On The Concourse.

west.description: To the west lies On The Concourse.

3143.description:
Here the Concourse passes beneath a long vaulted arcade built against
the city wall, its roof held on stout stone piers and its floor paved
with worn flags. Lamps in iron cages hang from the vault, burning even
at midday, and the noise of the street echoes along the arches. Stalls
once stood between the piers, and their sockets still pock the floor.
The arcade opens east onto the Concourse near Emerald Avenue and west
toward the corner where the wall turns.

3144.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies Northwest End Of The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3144.description:
The Concourse draws near the end of its run along the wall here, and the
sound of the river can be heard ahead past the rooftops. A tall stone
column stands at the roadside topped with a weathered bronze lantern,
lit each evening by the lamplighters. Cart ruts are worn deep into the
cobbles. The street continues north to the end of the Concourse by the
bridge and south along the wall.

3145.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3145.description:
Here the Concourse runs quiet and shaded, the wall on one hand and the
blind backs of warehouses on the other, so that little sun reaches the
cobbles. A carved boundary stone at the kerb marks where one ward of the
city ends and another begins. Dandelions push up between the paving
stones. The street goes on north toward the bridge end and south along
the wall.

3146.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3146.description:
Washerwomen's troughs line the foot of the wall along this part of the
Concourse, a long stone channel fed by a culvert where soapy water foams
and gurgles away into a drain. Lines of washing are strung across the
street between iron pegs driven into the wall. The air is damp and
smells of lye. The Concourse runs on north and back south toward Park
Road.

3147.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

east.description: To the east lies Park Road.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3147.description:
Park Road branches off east here from the Concourse, passing beneath a
stone archway carved with leaves and fruit, and through it you can
glimpse the green of garden trees. The Concourse itself goes on north
and south along the wall, busier at this corner where carts turn in and
out. Iron bollards protect the corners of the arch, scarred by many a
careless wheel. A notice board on the archway is plastered with
handbills.

3148.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3148.description:
The Concourse narrows here where a guardhouse of squat stone juts from
the wall, its single window barred and its door painted with the arms of
Garathorm. A bench beside the door is polished by the seats of off-duty
watchmen. Pigeon-grey slates cover the roofs of the houses across the
way. The street leads north toward the turning for Park Road and south
along the wall.

3149.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

3149.description:
This stretch of the Concourse is lined with rope-makers' and chandlers'
yards, their gates open on the street and the smell of tar and hemp
heavy on the air. The city wall looms over them, streaked dark where
rainwater runs down from the battlements. A worn stone marker set into
the wall shows the height of some long-ago flood. The Concourse goes on
north and back south.

203150.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

203150.description:
A watering trough cut from a single block of granite stands against the
wall here, fed by a lead pipe that drips steadily from a lion's-head
spout. The cobbles around it are always wet and dark, and moss grows
green in their joints. The Concourse runs north and south along the
inner face of the wall, between it and a row of tall, shuttered houses.
Somewhere nearby a smith's hammer rings.

extra_descs.lion spout lion's-head pipe:
The bronze lion's head is green with age, its mane worn smooth and its
jaws gaping. A steady trickle of water falls from its mouth into the
trough below.

203151.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

203151.description:
The Concourse turns north here from the corner of the city wall and runs
along its inner face, the great stones rising sheer and grey on one side
of the street. Lean-to sheds and cobblers' stalls huddle against the
foot of the wall, their roofs patched with sacking. The way goes on
north along the wall and back south to the corner. Smoke from the
stalls' braziers hangs in the still air.

203152.name: On The Concourse

east.description: To the east lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies On The Concourse.

west.description: To the west lies Northeast End Of The Concourse.

203152.description:
The Concourse runs here in the lee of the city wall, a broad way of
flagstones where carts were once turned. The wall rises close by, grey
and patched, its stones furred with moss in the cracks. The Concourse
turns south along the wall, and west it leads back to the Northeast End
Of The Concourse. East, the way bends round and seems to come back on
itself, as the old streets of Garathorm sometimes do.

203153.name: On The Concourse

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies Hole in the wall.

203153.description:
The Concourse narrows here between the city wall and the blank backs of
houses, and the flagstones give way to rough cobbles. Weeds push up
along the foot of the wall, and a broken water butt leans beneath a
rain-stained gutter pipe. North, the Concourse widens again, while a
battered door south is set into a gap between two buildings, a hole in
the wall that most passers-by never notice.

203154.name: Hole in the wall

north.description: To the north lies On The Concourse.

south.description: To the south lies Dark Alley.

203154.description:
This is little more than a gap knocked through the backs of two houses
and roofed over with planks, a cramped hole in the wall barely wide
enough for two to pass. The bricks are rough and crumbling, and water
drips from the boards above into a puddle on the floor. A door north
opens onto the Concourse, and another door south leads into the gloom of
a dark alley.

203155.name: Dark Alley

north.description: To the north lies Hole in the wall.

south.description: To the south lies Dark Alley.

west.description: To the west lies Storage Shed.

203155.description:
The dark alley here runs beneath overhanging upper storeys that meet
overhead and shut out all but a grey crack of light. The walls are slick
with damp and covered in thieves' marks scratched into the plaster. A
rickety door west opens into a storage shed, and the alley creeps on
south into deeper shadow. North, the way back leads to the hole in the
wall.

3156.name: Storage Shed

east.description: To the east lies Dark Alley.

3156.description:
This storage shed is a little larger than its neighbours, built of
tarred boards under a roof that leaks in one corner. Empty crates have
been stacked into a rough wall, and someone has chalked tallies and
strange signs on the boards above them. Damp has blackened the floor
along one side where the rain gets in. A door east opens back into the
dark alley.

3157.name: Storage shed

east.description: To the east lies Dark Alley.

3157.description:
Shelves of rough planking line the walls of this cramped storage shed,
bowed in the middle from years of heavy loads now long gone. The single
window is boarded over, and thin bars of grey light fall through the
gaps onto a floor of packed earth. The place smells of mould and old
sacking. A plank door east lets back out into the dark alley.

3158.name: Dark Alley

north.description: To the north lies Dark Alley.

south.description: To the south lies Dark Alley.

west.description: To the west lies Storage shed.

3158.description:
Refuse has piled up against the walls of this cramped stretch of the
dark alley, and the smell of rot is thick under the low, sagging roof of
beams. A single guttering lamp in an iron bracket gives off more smoke
than light. West, a plank door hangs crookedly on its hinges at the
mouth of a storage shed. The alley runs north toward the hole in the
wall and south further into the dark.

3159.name: Dark Alley

north.description: To the north lies Dark Alley.

south.description: To the south lies Dark Alley.

3159.description:
The alley narrows so sharply here that your shoulders brush the cold,
sweating brick on both sides. Planks nailed across the gap overhead keep
out the rain but trap every smell, and old straw rots in heaps
underfoot. The way runs north toward the lamp-lit stretch of alley and
south into a dead end of shadow.

3160.name: Dark Alley

north.description: To the north lies Dark Alley.

3160.description:
The dark alley comes to an end here against a blank wall of old stone,
part of some forgotten building that Garathorm grew up around. Rusted
hooks and the stub of an iron bracket jut from the bricks, and a heap of
broken barrel staves fills the corner. It is very quiet, the noise of
the city reduced to a far murmur beyond the roof. The only way out is
north, back along the alley.

206400.name: Temple Entryway

east.description: To the east lies Temple Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies End Of Penny Lane.

206400.description:
Tall bronze doors stand open on the west side of this vaulted entryway,
letting in the noise of Penny Lane and a wash of daylight that fades
quickly on the cool stone floor. Within, the air is hushed and smells of
incense and candle wax. Seven gods are carved in a frieze above the
inner arch, each gazing down the long hall that runs east to their
chapels. A basin of holy water stands by the door for those who enter.

extra_descs.frieze gods seven:
The seven gods of the temple stand shoulder to shoulder in the frieze:
Livana with her wheat, Eranohk with his axe, Quaralin crowned with
stars, Veranalla rising from a wave, Jojeebe laughing, Zirande hooded
and Miylorei with open hands.

206401.name: Temple Hallway

east.description: To the east lies Temple Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Temple Entryway.

206401.description:
A long hallway of pale grey stone runs through the temple here, its
ceiling lost in shadow high above. Iron candle-stands line both walls,
their flames steady in the still air, and worn runners of red carpet
muffle every step. East, the hallway opens into a crossing where the
first chapels lie, and west the way leads back to the entryway and its
bronze doors.

206402.name: Temple Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Chapel of Livana.

east.description: To the east lies Temple Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel of Eranohk.

west.description: To the west lies Temple Hallway.

206402.description:
Here the hallway meets its first pair of chapels, their arched doors
facing each other across the flagstones. North, an arch wreathed in
carved flowers and vines opens into the Chapel of Livana, while south a
doorway framed in dark iron leads into the Chapel of Eranohk. The
hallway runs on east beneath a row of hanging lamps, and west back
toward the entryway.

206403.name: The Chapel of Livana

south.description: To the south lies Temple Hallway.

206403.description:
Green light falls through a window of stained glass into the small
Chapel of Livana, where living vines have been trained up the walls and
across the vaulted ceiling. A low altar of white stone holds bowls of
seeds and fresh blossoms, and the air smells of earth and spring. Carved
into the face of the altar, a woman with flowing hair holds a sheaf of
wheat. The arched door south returns to the temple hallway.

206404.name: The Chapel of Eranohk

north.description: To the north lies Temple Hallway.

206404.description:
Iron rules the stern Chapel of Eranohk: iron sconces, an iron-bound
altar, and old shields and swords hung in rows upon the walls as
offerings. The stone floor is scarred where worshippers have knelt in
armour, and a red lamp burns before a statue of a bearded warrior
leaning on a great axe. The air is cold and smells of oil and steel. The
iron-framed doorway north leads back into the hallway.

206405.name: Temple Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Chapel of Quaralin.

east.description: To the east lies Temple Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel of Veranalla.

west.description: To the west lies Temple Hallway.

206405.description:
The hallway runs on through the heart of the temple, and the sound of
distant chanting drifts along its vaulted length. North, a doorway
painted deep blue and spangled with silver stars opens on the Chapel of
Quaralin, and south a door carved with rolling waves leads into the
Chapel of Veranalla. More chapels lie east along the hall, and west it
returns toward the entryway.

206406.name: The Chapel of Quaralin

south.description: To the south lies Temple Hallway.

206406.description:
Deep blue paint covers the domed ceiling of the Chapel of Quaralin,
scattered with silver stars set out in the true shapes of the
constellations. Shelves of scrolls and star charts line one wall, and a
bronze orrery of turning spheres stands upon the altar. A few cushioned
stools wait for those who come to study or pray in silence. The starry
doorway south opens back onto the hallway.

extra_descs.orrery spheres bronze:
Seven bronze spheres hang on slender arms around a golden sun. A small
crank at the base turns them, and the priests say it shows the heavens
as they truly move.

206407.name: The Chapel of Veranalla

north.description: To the north lies Temple Hallway.

206407.description:
The Chapel of Veranalla is cool and echoing, its walls tiled in blue and
green like the depths of the sea. A broad basin of water sits where the
altar would be, fed by a thin trickle from a carved shell in the wall,
and its gentle sound fills the room. Ropes, oars and little carved boats
hang on the walls, left in thanks by sailors who came home. The wave-
carved door north leads back into the hallway.

206408.name: The Temple Sanctuary

west.description: To the west lies Temple Hallway.

206408.description:
The Temple Sanctuary is a high, round chamber beneath a gilded dome, lit
by a ring of windows that pour golden light down onto a great altar of
white marble. Seven tall candles burn upon it, one for each god of the
temple, and they never seem to gutter. The floor is inlaid with a great
sun of gold and amber stone, and rows of kneeling benches face the
altar. The gilded doors west lead back to the hallway.

extra_descs.seven candles altar:
The candles are as thick as a man's arm and never seem to grow shorter.
Each is a different colour, one for each of the seven gods, and their
flames burn straight and still.

206409.name: Temple Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Chapel of Jojeebe.

east.description: To the east lies Temple Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Chapel of Zirande.

west.description: To the west lies Temple Hallway.

206409.description:
The temple hallway grows dimmer here, the candle-stands set further
apart and the shadows thicker between them. North, a door painted in
cheerful patches of yellow and red leads into the Chapel of Jojeebe, and
from it comes the faint chime of bells. South, a plain black door marks
the Chapel of Zirande, silent and cold. The hallway continues east
toward the sanctuary and runs west back the way you came.

206410.name: The Chapel of Jojeebe

south.description: To the south lies Temple Hallway.

206410.description:
Bright patchwork hangings drape the walls of the Chapel of Jojeebe, and
strings of tiny brass bells hang from the ceiling, chiming at the
faintest draught. The altar is a round table painted like a gaming
board, its rim carved with dice and grinning masks. A smiling statue of
a jester with a cup raised in a toast stands behind it. The patched door
south leads back to the hallway.

206411.name: The Chapel of Zirande

north.description: To the north lies Temple Hallway.

206411.description:
The Chapel of Zirande is dark and very still, lit only by a single grey
candle in a recess behind the altar. Black hangings cover the walls,
embroidered with silver owls and the shapes of closed eyes. Upon the
