plain stone altar lies a carved figure of a hooded woman, her hands
folded over a key. Every footstep sounds too loud here, and the black
door north opens back into the hallway.

206412.name: The Chapel of Miylorei

south.description: To the south lies Temple Hallway.

206412.description:
Soft white curtains and a sweet smell of lavender fill the gentle Chapel
of Miylorei, goddess of healing and mercy. Low cots stand along one wall
for the sick who come to pray, and bundles of dried herbs hang from the
beams above them. On the altar a marble statue of a young woman holds
out her open hands, the stone of her palms worn smooth by countless
touches. The curtained doorway south leads back to the hallway.

206413.name: Temple Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Chapel of Miylorei.

east.description: To the east lies The Temple Sanctuary.

west.description: To the west lies Temple Hallway.

206413.description:
The hallway ends here before a pair of tall gilded doors that open east
into the Temple Sanctuary, and a golden light spills through them onto
the floor. North, a doorway hung with soft white curtains leads into the
Chapel of Miylorei, and the scent of lavender drifts out from it.
Tapestries of the seven gods line the walls, and the hallway runs back
west past the other chapels.

206700.name: Bazaar Street

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

west.description: To the west lies Emerald Avenue.

206700.description:
Bazaar Street begins here where it leaves Emerald Avenue, and at once
the air fills with the cries of hawkers and the smell of spice and
roasting nuts. Coloured awnings stretch from house to house overhead,
turning the daylight into a patchwork of red and saffron. The street
runs east into the heart of the bazaar, and west it opens onto the
quieter cobbles of Emerald Avenue.

206701.name: Bazaar Street

north.description: To the north lies Imrik's Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

south.description: To the south lies Ruby's Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

206701.description:
Two shopfronts face each other across this stretch of Bazaar Street.
North, Imrik's Shop hangs out a crooked wooden sign beside a dusty bow
window, while south, Ruby's Shop glitters behind small panes of red
glass. The cobbles here are strewn with straw and trodden fruit, and a
tinker's bell clangs somewhere along the street. The bazaar continues
east, and west it leads back toward Emerald Avenue.

206702.name: Imrik's Shop

south.description: To the south lies Bazaar Street.

206702.description:
Imrik's Shop is a narrow, cluttered room where shelves climb all the way
to the ceiling, reached by a ladder that slides along a rail. A long
counter scarred by knives and coins divides the shop, and a brass scale
stands at one end of it. Lamps of every shape hang from the beams,
though only a few are ever lit. The shop door south opens onto Bazaar
Street.

206703.name: Ruby's Shop

north.description: To the north lies Bazaar Street.

206703.description:
Ruby's Shop glows warm and red, its walls hung with rose-coloured silk
and its lamps shaded with garnet glass that turns the light the colour
of wine. A cushioned bench runs beneath the window, and a long counter
of cherrywood is inlaid with a pattern of small red stones. The faint
scent of roses lingers about the place. The door leads north onto Bazaar
Street.

206704.name: Bazaar Street

north.description: To the north lies Jelloz's Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

south.description: To the south lies Sargoth's Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

206704.description:
The bazaar grows louder here, the street hemmed in by trestles and
barrows that spill out from the shops. North, Jelloz's Shop is painted a
startling shade of green, and south the dark doorway of Sargoth's Shop
is flanked by a pair of carved wooden wolves. A public fountain of
chipped stone stands in a recess in the wall, its spout shaped like a
lion's head. The street runs on east and west through the market din.

206705.name: Jelloz's Shop

south.description: To the south lies Bazaar Street.

206705.description:
Every wall of Jelloz's Shop is painted the same bright green as its
front, and the shelves are stacked with stoppered jars of every size.
The air is sweet and sticky, smelling of sugar and preserved fruit. A
long counter of green-stained wood runs across the room, with a little
brass bell upon it for summoning service. The door south leads back out
onto Bazaar Street.

206706.name: Sargoth's Shop

north.description: To the north lies Bazaar Street.

206706.description:
Sargoth's Shop is a stark, bare-walled room of dark stone with an iron
grille across the counter, behind which the shelves stand in shadow. A
forge-black lamp hangs on a chain and swings slightly whenever the door
opens. Deep gouges mar the wooden floor, as though something heavy was
once dragged across it and out. The door opens north onto Bazaar Street.

206707.name: Bazaar Street

north.description: To the north lies Bazaar Street.

east.description: To the east lies Silvina's Shop.

south.description: To the south lies Akaniz's Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

206707.description:
Here Bazaar Street turns a corner, and the din of the market eddies
around it like water round a stone. East, Silvina's Shop shows a narrow
front of silver-grey stone with a delicate sign of a crescent moon.
South, Akaniz's Shop is half hidden behind a curtain of hanging rugs and
brass lamps. The street bends north between the stalls and runs back
west through the bazaar.

206708.name: Akaniz's Shop

north.description: To the north lies Bazaar Street.

206708.description:
Akaniz's Shop is a long, low room hung with woven rugs from far lands,
their reds and ochres faded by sun and smoke. Brass lamps with coloured
panes cast patterns across cushions heaped along the walls, and a small
charcoal brazier keeps a copper kettle simmering. The smell of strong
tea and spice fills the air. The door leads north out onto Bazaar
Street.

206709.name: Silvina's Shop

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

206709.description:
Silvina's Shop is quiet and graceful, its walls washed in pale silver-
grey and its floor laid with polished boards that gleam under hanging
lamps of pierced silver. Glass cases on slender legs stand in a neat
row, and a carved bowl of dried lavender is set into the counter beside
a little silver bell. The whole room smells sweetly of it. Its glass-
paned door opens west onto Bazaar Street.

206710.name: Bazaar Street

north.description: To the north lies Bazaar Street.

east.description: To the east lies Cardini's Shop.

south.description: To the south lies Bazaar Street.

west.description: To the west lies Bedlamzer's Shop.

206710.description:
A stone archway spans the street here, so old that its carvings have
worn to vague, friendly lumps. East, Cardini's Shop is fronted by a
striped awning and a board chalked with the day's bargains, while west
the door of Bedlamzer's Shop is painted with whirling spirals that make
the eye swim. The cobbles rise gently north under more awnings and fall
away south to the bend in the street.

206711.name: Cardini's Shop

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

206711.description:
Cardini's Shop is a neat little parlour with a card table of green baize
at its centre and velvet drapes drawn across a painted backdrop of
stars. Mirrors in gilt frames hang on every wall, so that the lamplight
multiplies and the room seems far larger than it is. A tall cabinet with
many small drawers stands behind the counter. A curtained doorway leads
west onto Bazaar Street.

206712.name: Bedlamzer's Shop

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

206712.description:
Bedlamzer's Shop is a riot of colour and noise, its walls painted in
clashing stripes and its rafters hung with bells, ribbons and paper
lanterns that jangle whenever the door swings. Wares are heaped on
tables in no order anyone but the owner could fathom. A cracked slate by
the counter is scrawled with prices in three colours of chalk. The door
leads east to Bazaar Street.

206713.name: Bazaar Street

north.description: To the north lies Bazaar Street.

east.description: To the east lies Palaon's Shop.

south.description: To the south lies Bazaar Street.

west.description: To the west lies Erraticus's Shop.

206713.description:
Bazaar Street climbs a short slope here, and the stalls give way to
proper shopfronts with glazed bow windows. East, Palaon's Shop is neat
and freshly whitewashed, its brass door handle polished bright. West,
Erraticus's Shop leans at a curious angle, its shutters hanging crooked
and smoke of an odd violet hue curling from its chimney. The street
continues north toward Merchant Avenue and south back down through the
bazaar.

6714.name: Palaon's Shop

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

6714.description:
Palaon's Shop is airy and light, with a high ceiling hung with a ring of
frosted lamps that shine down on a floor of blue and white tiles.
Slender shelves of pale ash hold their wares at eye height, and a small
fountain trickles into a basin by the counter. The room smells of
oranges and clean water. The door opens west onto Bazaar Street.

6715.name: Erraticus's Shop

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

6715.description:
Nothing in Erraticus's Shop stands quite straight, for the shelves tilt,
the counter leans, and the clocks on the far wall all tell a different
hour. Odd contraptions of brass wire and glass hang from the beams,
ticking and whirring to themselves. Scorch marks blacken one corner of
the ceiling above a cluttered workbench. The crooked door opens east
onto Bazaar Street.

6716.name: Bazaar Street

north.description: To the north lies Shagrat's Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

south.description: To the south lies Bazaar Street.

west.description: To the west lies Rhinocreed's Shop.

6716.description:
The bazaar ends here where Bazaar Street meets the wider cobbles of
Merchant Avenue, which opens east between the tall houses of wealthy
traders. North, a heavy door studded with nails marks Shagrat's Shop,
and west, Rhinocreed's Shop announces itself with a great carved horn
mounted above the lintel. A worn stone mounting block stands at the
corner. South, the awnings of the bazaar crowd down the slope of the
street.

6717.name: Rhinocreed's Shop

east.description: To the east lies Bazaar Street.

6717.description:
Rhinocreed's Shop is built heavy and square, its walls of rough grey
stone and its floor of flags laid thick enough to bear an ox. Racks of
stout timber stand along the walls, and a great iron-bound chest is
bolted to the floor behind the counter. A horned skull of some huge
beast is mounted above the hearth, yellow with age. The door leads east
out to Bazaar Street.

extra_descs.horned skull beast:
The skull is longer than a man's arm, with a single thick horn curving
up from the snout and a second, broken stump behind it. Someone has
rubbed the bone with oil until it shines like old ivory.

6718.name: Shagrat's Shop

south.description: To the south lies Bazaar Street.

6718.description:
Shagrat's Shop is a low, smoke-dark room with a ceiling of tarred beams
so close overhead that tall customers stoop beneath them. Iron hooks and
chains hang from the rafters, and a scarred counter of black oak runs
the width of the room, notched by years of blades tested against its
edge. A brazier glows in the corner and keeps the place warm and close.
The door opens south onto the noise of Bazaar Street.

6719.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies Atreides's Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

south.description: To the south lies Devilhand's Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Bazaar Street.

6719.description:
Merchant Avenue begins here, where the clamour of Bazaar Street to the
west gives way to a broader, better-kept way paved in dressed grey
stone. Shopfronts face each other across the street, Atreides's Shop
with its bow window to the north and Devilhand's Shop behind a red-
painted door to the south. Hanging signs creak on their irons overhead,
and the avenue runs on east between rows of merchants' houses. The
Temple dome rises pale above the rooftops.

6720.name: Atreides's Shop

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

6720.description:
Atreides's Shop is bright and orderly, lit by a broad bow window whose
small panes of bottle glass throw green-tinted light over the
floorboards. Tall cabinets with glazed doors line the walls, each shelf
labelled in a neat, upright hand, and a brass scale stands polished on
the counter. The air smells faintly of beeswax and cedar. The door at
the south side lets out onto Merchant Avenue.

6721.name: Devilhand's Shop

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

6721.description:
Devilhand's Shop is a cramped room behind a red-painted door, its walls
hung with crimson cloth and its ceiling blackened by the smoke of an oil
lamp shaped like a grinning face. A counter of dark stone divides it,
worn hollow in the middle by years of coins slid across. Odd charms
dangle on cords from the beams and turn slowly in the draught. The red
door opens north onto Merchant Avenue.

6722.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies Vyrath's Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

south.description: To the south lies Revenant's Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Merchant Avenue.

6722.description:
The avenue widens a little here around an old stone horse trough, its
water skimmed with fallen leaves and its rim worn smooth by idle hands.
Vyrath's Shop stands to the north behind a door studded with iron, while
Revenant's Shop to the south keeps its shutters painted a funereal
black. Merchant Avenue carries on east and west, its cobbles swept clean
each morning by the shopkeepers. Chimney smoke drifts low over the tiled
roofs.

6723.name: Vyrath's Shop

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

6723.description:
Vyrath's Shop is a narrow, deep room that smells of old parchment,
candle wax and something sharper beneath, like struck flint. Shelves
climb the walls to the ceiling, reached by a rolling ladder on an iron
rail, and a heavy curtain of dark velvet hides a back room from view. A
single lamp of green glass burns on the counter. The iron-studded door
opens south onto Merchant Avenue.

6724.name: Revenant's Shop

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

6724.description:
Revenant's Shop is dim and hushed behind its black shutters, lit only by
tall candles in iron sconces whose flames barely stir. The walls are
panelled in dark wood carved with twining thorns, and a glass-topped
case runs along the counter, its lock heavy and old. A faint chill hangs
in the air that no fire seems to touch. The door leads north back out to
Merchant Avenue.

6725.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies An Unpurchased Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

south.description: To the south lies An Unpurchased Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Merchant Avenue.

6725.description:
Here the avenue grows quieter, for the shops on both sides stand empty,
their windows dusty and their doors hung with weathered placards
offering them for sale. One empty shopfront waits to the north and
another to the south, both with fresh paint on the lintels as if someone
hoped to tempt a buyer. Merchant Avenue runs on east and back west
toward the busier stretch. A lamp post of black iron stands at the kerb,
its glass smoked from years of burning.

6726.name: An Unpurchased Shop

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

6726.description:
This empty shop has been swept clean and left bare, its floorboards pale
where a counter once stood and its walls marked with the ghosts of
vanished shelves. Dust motes turn in the light from a single grimy
window. A placard nailed inside the door announces that the premises may
be had for a fair price from the city's clerks. The door opens south
onto Merchant Avenue.

6727.name: An Unpurchased Shop

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

6727.description:
Bare and echoing, this empty shop is larger than it looks from the
street, running back into a deep alcove beneath a low arch. The whole
place is swept but unfurnished, and every footstep rings off the plaster
walls. A bill of sale, curling and yellow, is pasted beside the
doorframe. The door leads north to Merchant Avenue.

6728.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies An Unpurchased Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

south.description: To the south lies An Unpurchased Shop.

west.description: To the west lies Merchant Avenue.

6728.description:
A row of empty shops lines this stretch of Merchant Avenue, and the
street feels hushed after the bustle nearer the bazaar. Weeds have found
the cracks between the cobbles, and a broken sign bracket juts from the
wall with nothing hanging from it. Vacant shopfronts wait to the north
and to the south, each with a faded notice of sale in its window. The
avenue goes on east and west.

6729.name: An Unpurchased Shop

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

6729.description:
The last owner of this shop left in a hurry, by the look of it, for a
counter lies on its side against the far wall and a torn ledger cover is
nailed to the doorframe as if in spite. The plaster is cracked and
stained with damp in one corner, and the room smells of mice and old
soot from a cold hearth. Light comes only through the open door, which
leads south to Merchant Avenue.

6730.name: An Unpurchased Shop

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

6730.description:
A faint smell of tanned leather lingers in this empty shop, and a
workbench scored with awl marks stands abandoned beneath the window. The
shelves have been stripped and the hearth is dead, its iron fire-dogs
left behind to rust. Light falls grey through panes that no one has
washed in a season or two. A warped door swings north onto Merchant
Avenue.

6731.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies An Unpurchased Shop.

east.description: To the east lies Tolliver's Shop.

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

west.description: To the west lies Merchant Avenue.

6731.description:
Merchant Avenue bends here, turning south at a corner where a stone
mounting block stands for riders. Tolliver's Shop fills the end of the
street to the east, its doorway framed by carved wooden pillars, while
an empty shop with boarded windows sits to the north. The avenue runs
back west toward the bazaar and on south past more shopfronts. Rainwater
from the gutters of the corner house has worn a dark channel down its
wall.

6732.name: An Unpurchased Shop

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

6732.description:
Boards cover the window of this empty shop from the inside, and only
thin blades of daylight slip between them to stripe the dusty floor.
Someone has chalked a price on the wall and someone else has crossed it
out and chalked a lower one. A broken shutter leans in the corner beside
a cold, empty fireplace. The way out is south, back onto Merchant
Avenue.

6733.name: Tolliver's Shop

west.description: To the west lies Merchant Avenue.

6733.description:
Tolliver's Shop is a warm, crowded room under a high timber roof, its
walls hung with racks and pegs and its corners stacked with crates
stencilled with the marks of distant ports. A long counter of honey-
coloured pine divides the room, scarred with knife cuts and ring stains
from countless mugs. Lamps on chains light the place day and night. The
carved doorway leads west back onto Merchant Avenue.

6734.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

east.description: To the east lies An Unpurchased Shop.

south.description: To the south lies Merchant Avenue.

west.description: To the west lies An Unpurchased Shop.

6734.description:
The avenue runs straight here between tall, narrow houses whose upper
storeys lean out over the street until their eaves almost touch. Empty
shops face each other across the cobbles, one to the east and one to the
west, their doors locked and their sills thick with dust. Merchant
Avenue continues north to the corner and south toward Luko's Shop at its
end. Washing lines strung between the upper windows sway in the breeze.

6735.name: An Unpurchased Shop

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

6735.description:
This little shop is empty but in good repair, with fresh lime on the
walls and a new latch on the door, as if the city has made it ready for
whoever buys it next. Pale squares on the plaster show where pictures or
signs once hung. A small hearth sits cold and swept beneath a plain
stone mantel. The way out lies east, onto Merchant Avenue.

6736.name: An Unpurchased Shop

west.description: To the west lies Merchant Avenue.

6736.description:
A smell of old spice still clings to this empty shop, as though a dealer
in peppers and cloves once traded here and the walls kept the memory.
Shallow drawers are built into one wall, all of them pulled out and
empty, and the floor is stained with rings where barrels stood. Cobwebs
thicken in the corners of the low ceiling. The door leads west to
Merchant Avenue.

6737.name: Merchant Avenue

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

south.description: To the south lies Luko's Shop.

west.description: To the west lies An Unpurchased Shop.

6737.description:
Merchant Avenue comes to its end here before the painted front of Luko's
Shop to the south, where a hanging lantern burns in a cage of brass. An
empty shop with a sagging awning stands to the west, and a blank wall of
old brick closes off the rest of the street. The avenue leads back north
between its rows of shopfronts. Moss grows thick in the shade at the
foot of the wall.

6738.name: An Unpurchased Shop

east.description: To the east lies Merchant Avenue.

6738.description:
Rain has found its way into this empty shop through the sagging awning
outside, and a dark stain spreads across the floorboards from the
threshold. The walls are whitewashed but flaking, and a row of iron
hooks along one side hangs empty. An old counter, too heavy to carry
off, still squats in the middle of the room under a skin of dust. The
door leads east onto Merchant Avenue.

6739.name: Luko's Shop

north.description: To the north lies Merchant Avenue.

6739.description:
Luko's Shop is cosy and cluttered, a single room with a beamed ceiling
and a hearth of round river stones where a fire crackles in all seasons.
Shelves run every which way, some slanting, some crooked, all of them
packed close, and a painted sign above the counter promises fair
dealing. A threadbare rug softens the floor before the hearth. The door
opens north onto Merchant Avenue, beneath a brass lantern.

9784.name: Academy Path

south.description: To the south lies Inside the West Gate of Garathorm.

west.description: To the west lies Academy Path.

north.description: To the north lies Forest Edge.

9784.description:
Academy Path sets out from the city here, a lane of packed earth and
scattered cobbles leading away from the towers of the West Gate, which
lie just south. North, the lane gives out at the edge of a dark forest
whose old oaks stand thick and shadowed, while the path itself bends
west toward the School House. A wooden signpost leans at the fork, its
arms weathered grey. Wild grass grows tall along the verges.

9785.name: Academy Path

north.description: To the north lies Academy Path.

east.description: To the east lies Academy Path.

9785.description:
The path runs beside a broad hawthorn hedge here, worn into a shallow
trough by the feet of scholars coming and going. Through gaps in the
hedge you glimpse a close-cropped meadow, and the city wall shows grey
beyond the fields. The way turns north toward the School House and back
east to the signpost by the forest's edge. Wildflowers dot the banks.

9786.name: Academy Path

north.description: To the north lies Before the Garathorm School House.

south.description: To the south lies Academy Path.

9786.description:
Academy Path climbs a gentle rise here, its ruts filled with gravel to
spare the boots of students in the wet. An old milestone at the verge
has been carved over with initials and doodles, its proper inscription
long since worn away. Ahead to the north the roof and bell-cote of the
School House show above the trees, and the path drops back south toward
the hedges. A breeze stirs the long grass.

extra_descs.milestone stone:
Beneath the scratched initials and crude drawings you can just make out
a carved number and the faint shape of an open book, the old sign of the
School House.

9787.name: Before the Garathorm School House

north.description: To the north lies Entrance of the School House.

south.description: To the south lies Academy Path.

9787.description:
The path ends here in a small swept yard before the Garathorm School
House, a long building of honey-coloured stone with tall windows and a
bell-cote perched on its roof. Its heavy double doors stand open to the
north beneath a carved lintel. A slate board by the gate lists the day's
lessons in a schoolmaster's careful hand, and Academy Path runs back
south through the grass. Scuffed hopscotch squares are scratched into
the flags of the yard.

3006.name: The Entrance Hall Of The Grunting Boar Inn
3006.description:
This is the entrance hall of the Grunting Boar Inn. The hall has been
wisely decorated with simple, functional furniture. The heavy smell of
dust and aging paper drifts in from the Post Office to the north. A
small staircase leads up to the reception and the bar is to the east.
The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. Shadows gather in the
corners.

east.description: Surprise!  You see the bar.

south.description: To the south lies The Combat Practice Yard.

3007.name: The Grunting Boar
3007.description:
This is the bar. The bar is set against the northern wall, old archaic
writing, carvings and symbols cover its top. A fireplace is built into
the western wall, and through the southeastern windows you can see the
temple square. This place makes you feel like home. A small sign with
big letters is fastened to the bar. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The
air is still and musty.

west.description: You see the exit to the entrance hall.

extra_descs.bar carvings symbols: The carvings are older than the inn: names, dates, and one line repeated in six languages - 'the boar grunted first.'
extra_descs.fireplace: The fire never quite goes out. The landlord claims it has burned continuously since his grandmother's day.

3024.name: The Eastern End Of Poor Alley
3024.description:
This is the poor alley. South of here is the Grubby Inn and to the east
you see common square. The alley continues further west. Vendors and
pedestrians bustle past. Buildings crowd together on all sides.

south.description: You see the Inn.

north.description: To the north lies The Japanese Garden.

3048.name: Grubby Inn
3048.description:
This isside the old Grubby Inn. This place has not been cleaned for
several decades; vile smells make you dizzy. The ceiling hangs low
overhead. The air is still and musty.

north.description: You see the alley.

3032.name: Pet Shop Store
3032.description:
This is the small dark room in which the Pet shop keeps his pets. It is
vital that this room's virtual number is exactly one larger than the Pet
Shop number. Dust motes drift in the stale air. The walls are rough-hewn
and cold to the touch.

south.description: To the south lies The Gate To The Inner City.

3058.name: Ye Olde Water Shoppe
3058.description:
This is the center of a small wooden shop whose walls are covered with
racks upon racks of water jugs. Several large barrels with spigots are
stacked in the corner. The air is still and musty. Dust motes drift in
the stale air.

west.description: To the west lies The Cityguards' Barracks.

3069.name: First National Bank of Garathorm
3069.description:
The area opens in the marble-floored lobby of Garathorm's most
prestigious financial institution. Iron-barred teller windows line the
northern wall, where a well-dressed banker handles transactions with
efficient precision. Ornate columns support the vaulted ceiling, and oil
paintings of the city's founding merchants hang on the walls. A brass
plaque near the door reads 'Est. Year 1 of the Third Age'. Shadows
gather in the corners. The ceiling hangs low overhead.

south.description: The statue base cache is to the south.

extra_descs.banker windows lobby: The teller windows' iron bars are polished bright at hand height. The banker's smile is exact, weighed, and entirely uninsured.

3072.name: The Statue Base Cache
3072.description:
Hidden within the statue, this cramped chamber holds a few offerings, a
shallow basin, and a stone shelf carved with prayer marks. The ceiling
hangs low overhead. Shadows gather in the corners.

north.description: The bank is to the north.

east.description: To the east lies Harbour Square.

3073.name: The Old Watch Post
3073.description:
This cramped watch post overlooks the west gate through narrow slits. A
battered coffer sits against the wall, and the air smells of old oil and
smoke. The ceiling hangs low overhead. The air is still and musty.

east.description: To the east lies Wall Road.

extra_descs.coffer slits: Through the arrow slits, the west road unrolls toward the forest. The coffer's lock has been picked so many times it opens politely for anyone.

3074.name: The Forgotten Passage
3074.description:
A narrow passage descends into darkness. The walls are damp with
condensation and the air reeks of decay. This entrance was clearly
hidden for a reason - perhaps to keep something in, rather than keep
people out. The air is still and musty. The ceiling hangs low overhead.

down.description: The passage descends further into darkness.

west.description: To the west lies The Quay.

3075.name: The Sewer King's Domain
3075.description:
This vast chamber stinks of rot and refuse. Bones litter the floor, and
makeshift totems of rat skulls line the walls. A crude throne of garbage
and bones sits at the far end. Something large and terrible rules here.
The air is still and musty. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the
touch.

up.description: The passage leads back toward the surface.

east.description: A dark tunnel leads deeper into the sewers.

extra_descs.throne totems bones: The throne of garbage and bone is arranged with real care. Whatever rules down here has opinions about majesty.

3076.name: The Shadow Crossing
3076.description:
The darkness here is unnatural, seeming to swallow even magical light.
Shadows move of their own accord along the walls. You feel watched by
unseen eyes. The air is deathly cold. The ceiling hangs low overhead.
Dust motes drift in the stale air.

west.description: The tunnel leads back to the Sewer King's domain.

north.description: An ancient archway leads to something older...

east.description: A passage wreathed in shadow leads to an ancient sanctum.

3077.name: The Guardian's Vault
3077.description:
This ancient chamber predates the city above by millennia. Runes of
power are carved into every surface, pulsing with faint light. At the
center stands a massive stone golem, eternally vigilant. Behind it, a
treasure chest gleams with promise. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to
the touch. The ceiling hangs low overhead.

south.description: The archway leads back to the shadows.

extra_descs.golem runes: The golem's eyes track you without light. The runes pulse in rhythm - not your heartbeat, you realize slowly. Its own.

3080.name: The Threshold of Shadows
3080.description:
The air grows cold and heavy as you enter this passage. Torches burn
with an eerie green flame, casting dancing shadows on walls etched with
runic symbols of death and rebirth. The scent of grave soil and ancient
incense hangs in the still air. A foreboding presence seems to watch
from the darkness beyond.

west.description: The Shadow Crossing lies to the west.

north.description: A corridor of bones leads deeper into the sanctum.

3081.name: The Bone Corridor
3081.description:
Skulls and bones of countless creatures line the walls of this macabre
hallway, arranged in intricate patterns that seem almost artistic in
their grotesque beauty. Candles flicker in empty eye sockets, providing
weak illumination. The bones whisper secrets to those who know how to
listen. The corridor opens into a larger chamber to the north.

south.description: The threshold lies to the south.

north.description: The main hall of the guild awaits.

extra_descs.skulls bones candles patterns: Look long enough and the bone patterns resolve into script. The candlelight makes the empty sockets seem to read along with you.

3082.name: The Necromancers' Guild
3082.description:
This vaulted chamber serves as the heart of the Necromancers' Guild.
Ancient tomes line shelves carved from black stone, their pages filled
with forbidden knowledge. A ritual circle inlaid with silver dominates
the floor, surrounded by candelabras dripping with black wax. The air
hums with dark energy, and the veil between life and death feels thin
here.

south.description: The bone corridor leads back.

east.description: A private study lies beyond a dark curtain.

extra_descs.tomes circle shelves: The silver ritual circle is worn thin at the northern arc, where generations of necromancers have stood to ask the same question of the dark.

3083.name: The Inner Sanctum
3083.description:
This private study belongs to the guildmaster. Shelves hold preserved
specimens in jars, reagents for dark rituals, and scrolls of ancient
power. A desk covered in notes and diagrams sits against one wall.
A summoning circle is etched permanently into the stone floor, faint
traces of otherworldly energy still lingering within its bounds.

west.description: The main guild hall lies beyond the curtain.

3078.name: The Training Grounds
3078.description:
This open courtyard serves as Garathorm's training grounds, where new
adventurers learn the art of combat. Straw dummies stand in neat rows,
bearing the scars of countless practice sessions. Wooden weapon racks
line the walls, and the ground is packed hard from years of footwork
drills. A grizzled sergeant watches over the area, occasionally barking
corrections at those whose form displeases him. The Temple Square lies
to the north. Vendors and pedestrians bustle past. The smell of smoke
and humanity hangs in the air.

west.description: The Entrance To The Order Of Paladins

east.description: To the east lies The Gate Of The Inner City.

extra_descs.dummies weapons courtyard: Notches on the rack post tally every student who graduated to the real thing. The column is taller than you are.

3085.name: The Entrance To The Order Of Paladins
3085.description: A wide stone archway opens into the hallowed halls of the Order of Paladins. The walls are adorned with polished shields bearing the sigils of holy warriors who served Garathorm through the ages. A silver chandelier hangs overhead, casting warm light across the marble floor. The sound of prayer drifts from the inner sanctum to the west.

east.description: The cobblestones lead to The Training Grounds

west.description: The cobblestones lead to The Sanctum Of The Holy Order

extra_descs.shields archway sigils: Every shield bears a different sigil and the same dents. Service in the Order is evidently democratic about danger.

3086.name: The Sanctum Of The Holy Order
3086.description: The inner sanctum of the Paladin Order is a place of quiet reverence. An altar of white marble stands at the center, flanked by racks of blessed weapons and gleaming armor. Stained glass windows depict scenes of righteous battle against the forces of darkness. The paladin guildmaster stands ready to guide those who walk the path of honor.

east.description: The Entrance To The Order Of Paladins

extra_descs.altar windows glass: At dawn the stained glass pours its saints across the floor in color; the paladins drill in their light without ever stepping on a face.

3000.name: wizard
3000.long_desc: A wizard walks around behind the counter, talking to himself.
3000.description:
The wizard looks old and senile, and yet he looks like a very powerful
wizard.  He is equipped with fine clothing, and is wearing many fine
rings and bracelets.

3001.name: baker
3001.long_desc: The baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
3001.description:
A fat, nice looking baker.  But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

3002.name: grocer
3002.long_desc: A grocer stands at the counter, with a slightly impatient look on his face.
3002.description: A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his shoulders.

3003.name: weaponsmith
3003.description:
He is a young weaponsmith, who still has lots to learn but he is still
eager to sell you his latest implements of carnage and destruction.

3004.name: armourer
3004.long_desc: An armourer stands here displaying his new (and previously owned) armours.
3004.description:
An old but very strong armourer.  He has made more suits of armour in his
life than you have ever seen.

3005.name: receptionist
3005.long_desc: A receptionist is standing behind the counter here, smiling at you.
3005.description:
You notice a tired look in her face.  She looks like she isn't paid well
enough to put up with any crap from mud players with attitudes.

3006.name: captain
3006.long_desc: A retired captain stands here, selling boats.
3006.description: This captain has eaten more sharks than you have killed peas.

3007.name: sailor
3007.long_desc: A sailor stands here, waiting to help you.
3007.description: He looks like a strong, fit sailor.

3008.name: uncle
3008.long_desc: Uncle Juan is here ready to take your order.
3008.description: He looks like he may or may not have a green card.

3009.name: wally
3009.long_desc: Wally the Watermaster is standing behind the counter.
3009.description:
Wally is a bit pudgy but looks very strong.  He has a glass of Garathorm
Natural Spring Water in his hand.  When he notices you, he proudly
displays his fine collection of contemporary waters.

3010.name: postmaster
3010.long_desc: The head postmaster is standing here, waiting to help you with your mail.
3010.description:
The Postmaster seems like a happy old man, though a bit sluggish.  He
worries about the reputation of the MMS (Garathorm Mail Service), as many
people seem to think that it is slow.  Perhaps if he were to brush the
cobwebs from his uniform it would help to make a better impression.

3020.name: guildmaster
3020.long_desc: Your guildmaster is studying a spellbook while preparing to cast a spell.
3020.description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic clothing,
and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

3021.name: guildmaster
3021.long_desc: Your guildmaster is prayer to your God here.
3021.description:
You are in no doubt that this guildmaster is truly close to your God; he
has a peaceful, loving look.  You notice that he is surrounded by a white
aura.

3022.name: guildmaster
3022.long_desc: A beggar is sitting here, could she be a guildmaster?
3022.description:
You realize that whenever your guildmaster moves, you fail to notice it -
the way of the true thief.  She is to be dressed in poor clothing, having
the appearance of a beggar.

3023.name: guildmaster
3023.long_desc: Your guildmaster is standing here sharpening an axe.
3023.description:
This is your master. Big and strong with bulging muscles. Several scars
across his body proves that he was using arms before you were born. He
has a calm look on his face.

3024.name: sorcerer
3024.long_desc: A sorcerer is guarding the entrance.
3024.description:
He is an experienced mage who has specialized in the field of Combat Magic.
He is here to guard the Mage's Guild and his superior knowledge of offensive
as well as defensive spells make him a deadly opponent.

3025.name: knight
3025.long_desc: A knight templar is guarding the entrance.
3025.description:
He is a specially trained warrior belonging to the military order of the
Faith.  His duty is to protect the faithful from persecution and infidel
attacks and his religious devotion combined with his superior skill makes
him a deadly opponent.

3026.name: assassin
3026.long_desc: An assassin is guarding the entrance.
3026.description:
He is a thief who has specialized in killing others as effectively as
possible, using all sorts of weapons.  His superior knowledge of how
and where to use them combined with his extraordinary stealth makes
him a deadly opponent.

3027.name: knight
3027.long_desc: A knight is guarding the entrance.
3027.description:
He is an expert warrior who has attained knighthood through countless
chivalrous deeds.  His duty is to protect the Guild of Swordsmen and his
extreme skill combined with his experience in warfare makes him a deadly
opponent.

3040.name: bartender
3040.long_desc: A bartender watches you calmly, while he skillfully mixes a drink.
3040.description: A tired looking Bartender who hates trouble in his bar.

3041.name: waiter
3041.long_desc: A waiter is going around from one place to another.

3042.name: waiter
3042.long_desc: A man now leads a quiet, peaceful life as a waiter is standing here.
3042.description:
This man was obviously a famous sorcerer in his younger days as you
instantly recognize his face.

3043.name: waiter
3043.long_desc: A waiter who seems to have reached contact with his God is standing here.
3043.description:
This waiter almost makes you feel like you should drop to your knees
and begin to worship your God.  Naaah.

3044.name: waiter
3044.long_desc: A waiter who knows where all his customers keep their money is standing here.
3044.description: Hmmm... wonder where he got that coin he is playing with.

3045.name: waiter
3045.description:
This guy looks like he could easily kill you while still carrying
quite a few firebreathers.

3046.name: filthy
3046.long_desc: Filthy is standing here, eager to serve you a special drink.
3046.description:
Filthy looks real, ehm, dirty.  He likes to keep his customers happy,
but do not mess with him or else he'll get upset.

3059.name: keeper
3059.long_desc: A Peacekeeper is standing here, ready to jump in at the first sign of trouble.
3059.description: He looks very strong and wise.  Looks like he doesn't answer to ANYONE.

3060.name: cityguard
3060.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

3061.name: janitor
3061.long_desc: A janitor is walking around, cleaning up.
3061.description: What a tough job he has.

3062.name: fido
3062.long_desc: A beastly fido is mucking through the garbage looking for food here.
3062.description:
The fido is a small dog that has a foul smell and pieces of rotted meat
hanging around his teeth.

3063.name: mercenary
3063.long_desc: A mercenary is waiting for a job here.
3063.description: He looks pretty mean, and you imagine he'd do anything for money.

3064.name: drunk
3064.description: A drunk who seems to be too happy, and to carry too much money.

3065.name: beggar
3065.long_desc: A beggar is here, asking for a few coins.
3065.description: The beggar looks like she is fed up with life.

3066.name: odif
3066.long_desc: An odif yltsaeb is here, walking backwards.
3066.description: The odif is a small god that has been reversed by some dog.

3067.name: cityguard
3067.long_desc: A cityguard is here, guarding the gate.
3067.description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

3068.name: green
3068.long_desc: An oozing green gelatinous blob is here, sucking in bits of debris.
3068.description: A horrid looking thing; it is huge, greenish, and looks like the blob.

3089.name: pet
3089.long_desc: There is a Pet Shop Boy standing here cuddleing something furry in his hands.
3089.description: As you look at him, he opens his hands to reveal a rat!

3090.name: kitten
3090.long_desc: A small loyal kitten is here.
3090.description: The kitten looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

3091.name: puppy
3091.long_desc: A small loyal puppy is here.
3091.description: The puppy looks like a cute, little, fierce fighter.

3092.name: beagle
3092.long_desc: A small, quick, loyal beagle is here.
3092.description: The beagle looks like a fierce fighter.

3093.name: rottweiler
3093.long_desc: A large, loyal rottweiler is here.
3093.description: The rottweiler looks like a strong, fierce fighter.

3094.name: wolf
3094.long_desc: A large, trained wolf is here.
3094.description: The wolf looks like a strong, fearless fighter.

3095.name: cryogenicist
3095.long_desc: The cryogenicist is here, playing with a canister of liquid nitrogen.
3095.description:
You notice a tired look in her face.  She looks like she isn't paid well
enough to put up with any crap from mud players with attitudes.

3110.name: guide
3110.long_desc: A friendly temple guide stands here, ready to help new adventurers.
3110.description: The temple guide smiles warmly and looks eager to offer advice to newcomers.

3111.name: banker
3111.long_desc: A well-dressed bank teller stands behind a brass counter.
3111.description: The bank teller keeps a careful eye on the ledgers, ready to assist with deposits or withdrawals.

3014.name: sewer king
3014.description: The Sewer King is a hulking rat-man, easily seven feet tall. His matted fur is slick with filth, and he wears a crude crown fashioned from the bones of his victims. His beady red eyes gleam with cunning malice.

3015.name: shadow assassin
3015.long_desc: A figure cloaked in living darkness watches from the shadows.
3015.description: The shadow assassin seems to flicker in and out of existence. Where its face should be, there is only darkness. It moves with supernatural grace, daggers dripping with poison.

3016.name: ancient guardian
3016.long_desc: A towering stone golem stands watch, runes glowing on its body.
3016.description: The Ancient Guardian has stood here for millennia. Its stone body is covered in protective runes that pulse with arcane energy. It attacks any who would disturb the treasure it protects.

3130.name: street urchin
3130.long_desc: A scrappy young street urchin darts about, eyes alert for opportunity.
3130.description: This young urchin has learned to survive on the streets of Garathorm. Quick and nimble, they know every alley and shortcut in the city.

3131.name: stray dog
3131.long_desc: A thin, mangy dog sniffs around for scraps.
3131.description: This poor dog has been living on the streets, scrounging for whatever food it can find.

3132.name: drunk patron
3132.long_desc: A drunk patron stumbles about, mumbling incoherently.
3132.description: This patron has clearly had far too much to drink. They sway unsteadily and occasionally burst into song.

3133.name: pickpocket
3133.long_desc: A shifty-eyed figure lurks in the shadows, watching for easy marks.
3133.description: This pickpocket has quick hands and quicker feet. They prey on distracted travelers and unwary merchants.

3134.name: rat
3134.long_desc: A large rat scurries about, searching for food.
3134.description: An oversized rat, bold enough to venture out even in daylight.

3030.name: ranger
3030.long_desc: A weathered ranger stands here, bow at the ready.
3030.description: This grizzled tracker has spent decades in the wild. Scars from countless hunts mark her arms, and her keen eyes miss nothing.

3031.name: paladin
3031.long_desc: A holy knight in shining armor kneels in prayer.
3031.description: This noble knight radiates an aura of righteousness. His armor gleams with divine light, and his sword bears holy runes.

3032.name: bard
3032.long_desc: A flamboyant bard strums a lute while humming a tune.
3032.description: This charismatic performer has traveled the world collecting songs and stories. Her voice can charm friend and foe alike.

3033.name: necromancer
3033.long_desc: A hooded figure shrouded in dark mist stands here.
3033.description: Shadows seem to cling to this master of death. Pale hands emerge from dark robes, and the faint smell of decay follows him.

3200.name: Sage Aldric
3200.long_desc: Sage Aldric stands here, ready to guide new adventurers.
3200.description:
Sage Aldric is an elderly man with a long white beard and kind, knowing eyes. He wears simple robes of deep blue, adorned with silver runes. A faint aura of wisdom surrounds him, and his voice carries the weight of countless years spent guiding young adventurers.

He seems eager to help newcomers find their way.

ai_config.greet_message: Ah, a new face! Welcome to Garathorm, traveler. I am Sage Aldric. If you seek guidance, simply speak with me.

topics.help: I can teach you the ways of survival in these lands. Would you like to begin your training?
topics.quest: I offer guidance to those new to adventuring. Type 'quest' to see what tasks await you.
topics.midgaard: This city has stood for centuries as a beacon of civilization. The Temple behind me is sacred ground.
topics.combat: Combat is a necessary skill. South of the square are training grounds where you can practice safely.
topics.skills: Each class has unique abilities. New ones come as you gain levels, and each grows stronger every time you use it. Once you have mastered one, your guild's trainer can teach you the rest.

3201.name: training dummy
3201.long_desc: A straw training dummy stands here, waiting to be struck.
3201.description: This is a man-shaped dummy made of burlap and stuffed with straw. It's mounted on a wooden post and has clearly seen better days - countless sword cuts and arrow holes mark its surface. Perfect for practicing your combat skills without real danger.

3202.name: combat instructor
3202.long_desc: Sergeant Bron stands here, watching recruits with a critical eye.
3202.description: Sergeant Bron is a grizzled veteran with a scarred face and arms like tree trunks. He wears worn but well-maintained armor and carries a wooden practice sword. His eyes constantly scan for poor form or lazy swings.

ai_config.greet_message: You there! Looking to train? The dummies won't hit back - much. Show me what you've got!

topics.train: Attack the dummies to practice: every swing and every skill you use makes you better at it. Use 'kill dummy' to begin. For training past mastery, ask your own guild's trainer.
topics.combat: In combat, you attack automatically each round. Use skills and spells to gain advantage.
topics.flee: If a fight goes bad, type 'flee' to escape. No shame in living to fight another day.

3096.name: tabby cat
3096.long_desc: A friendly tabby cat purrs softly here.
3096.description: This orange tabby cat has bright green eyes and a gentle disposition.

3097.name: raven
3097.long_desc: A glossy black raven perches here, watching with intelligent eyes.
3097.description: This large raven has glossy black feathers and remarkably intelligent eyes.

3098.name: green snake
3098.long_desc: A green snake coils here, flicking its tongue.
3098.description: This bright green snake is non-venomous but makes an exotic companion.

3099.name: guildmaster harlan auctioneer
3099.long_desc: Guildmaster Harlan stands behind a wide oak counter, overseeing the Auction House.
3099.description:
Guildmaster Harlan is a broad-shouldered dwarf with keen eyes and ink-stained
fingers. He runs Garathorm's Auction House with ruthless efficiency, ensuring
every transaction is fair — for a reasonable fee, of course. His oak counter
is covered with ledgers, contracts, and a brass bell.

3011.name: trained war dog
3011.long_desc: A large trained war dog stands guard here, muscles rippling.
3011.description: This powerful war dog has been bred and trained for combat.

3012.name: black bear
3012.long_desc: A young black bear lumbers here, sniffing curiously.
3012.description: This young black bear has been raised from a cub and is surprisingly docile.

3013.name: dire wolf
3013.long_desc: A massive dire wolf stands here, its silver fur bristling.
3013.description: This enormous wolf dwarfs ordinary wolves. Its silver eyes gleam with primal intelligence.

3100.name: maid
3100.long_desc: The Maid is waiting for your order.
3100.description:
She is very beautiful with golden hair, and deep blue eyes.  A good reason
for coming here more often, you think to yourself.

3101.name: sexton
3101.long_desc: A Sexton is sitting here, drinking hot tea.
3101.description: The Sexton looks like he is relaxing after another gravedigging job.

3102.name: chief
3102.long_desc: The Chief Guard is looking very upset.

3103.name: cityguard
3103.long_desc: A cityguard stands here, looking very upset.

3104.name: secretary
3104.long_desc: A secretary is sitting at the desk, typing away on the typewriter.
3104.description:
She looks very busy.

The Secretary says 'Sorry, but the Mayor is extremely busy today.'
The Secretary says 'Please sit down and have a seat in the meantime.'

3105.name: mayor
3105.long_desc: The Mayor is sitting in his huge chair, snoring loudly.
3105.description: He is a stocky, middle-aged man with thin, grey hair.

3106.name: crier
3106.long_desc: The Town Crier is here, weeping quietly.
3106.description: He is very good at his job - completely dissolved in tears.

3120.name: swan
3120.long_desc: A swan is swimming around in the pond.
3120.description: The white swan is very elegant.

3121.name: duckling
3121.long_desc: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
3121.description: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.

3122.name: sparrow
3122.long_desc: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
3122.description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

3123.name: duck
3123.long_desc: A duck is here, quacking happily.
3123.description: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.

3000.name: barrel
3000.room_desc: A beer barrel has been left here.

3001.name: bottle
3001.room_desc: A beer bottle has been left here.

3002.name: bottle
3002.room_desc: A dark bottle of ale has been left here.

3003.name: bottle
3003.room_desc: A bottle of firebreather has been left here.

3004.name: bottle
3004.room_desc: A dark bottle has been left here.

3005.name: key
3005.room_desc: A key made of a dull metal is lying on the ground here.

3009.name: waybread
3009.room_desc: Some waybread has been put here.

3010.name: bread
3010.room_desc: A loaf of bread has been left here.

3011.name: danish
3011.room_desc: A nice looking delicious danish pastry has been placed here.

3012.name: taco
3012.room_desc: A tasty looking Mexican taco has been dropped here.

3013.name: burrito
3013.room_desc: A spicy looking burrito has been set here.

3014.name: nachos
3014.room_desc: Some nachos have been left here.

3015.name: meat
3015.room_desc: A rather dubious looking piece of meat is on the ground here.

3020.name: dagger
3020.room_desc: A dagger with a long thin blade is here.

3022.name: sword
3022.room_desc: A long sword has been left here.

3023.name: club
3023.room_desc: A simple looking wooden club is here.

3024.name: warhammer
3024.room_desc: A medium sized warhammer is here.

3034.name: atm
3034.room_desc: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.

3035.name: fountain
3035.room_desc: A large fountain carved from blue-streaked marble is here, bubbling merrily.
3035.description: This magnificent fountain is carved from blue-streaked marble. Crystal clear water bubbles up from the center, cascading down in gentle streams. The peaceful sound of flowing water fills the square.

3036.name: cashcard
3036.room_desc: A handy dandy cashcard is sitting on the ground here.

3038.name: nail
3038.room_desc: A penny nail lies in the dust.

3039.name: pot
3039.room_desc: A cast-iron pot sits on the ground.

3040.name: plate
3040.room_desc: A breast plate is lying on the ground.

3041.name: shirt
3041.room_desc: A chain mail shirt is lying on the ground.

3042.name: shield
3042.room_desc: A small wooden shield is lying on the ground.

3043.name: jacket
3043.room_desc: A soft leather jacket is lying on the ground.

3044.name: jacket
3044.room_desc: A studded leather jacket is lying on the ground.

3045.name: jacket
3045.room_desc: A scale mail jacket is lying on the ground.

3046.name: plate
3046.room_desc: A bronze breast plate is lying on the ground.

3050.name: scroll
3050.room_desc: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

3051.name: potion
3051.short_desc: a yellow potion of see invisible
3051.room_desc: A small yellow potion has carelessly been left here.

3052.name: scroll
3052.room_desc: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

3053.name: wand
3053.room_desc: A grey wand has carelessly been left here.

3054.name: staff
3054.room_desc: A gnarled staff has carelessly been left here.

3055.name: staff
3055.room_desc: A metal staff has carelessly been left here.

3060.name: raft
3060.room_desc: A raft has been left here.

3061.name: canoe
3061.room_desc: A canoe has been left here.

3070.name: gauntlets
3070.room_desc: A pair of bronze gauntlets is lying on the ground.

3071.name: gloves
3071.room_desc: A pair of leather gloves is lying on the ground.

3075.name: helmet
3075.room_desc: A bronze helmet is lying on the ground.

3076.name: cap
3076.room_desc: A leather cap is lying on the ground.

3080.name: leggings
3080.room_desc: A pair of bronze leggings is lying on the ground.

3081.name: pants
3081.room_desc: A pair of leather pants is lying on the ground.

3085.name: sleeves
3085.room_desc: A pair of bronze sleeves is lying on the ground.

3086.name: sleeves
3086.room_desc: A pair of leather sleeves is lying on the ground.

3096.name: board
3096.room_desc: A large, sociable bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

3097.name: board
3097.room_desc: A large bulletin board is here, carved from a block of ice.

3098.name: board
3098.room_desc: A large bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.  It glows with a faint aura.

3099.name: board
3099.room_desc: A large bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

3100.name: fountain marble
3100.room_desc: A beautiful marble fountain stands here, water trickling peacefully.
3100.description: This ornate marble fountain features carved dolphins spouting crystal-clear water into a wide basin. The water is cool and refreshing.

3101.name: bread loaf
3101.room_desc: A fresh loaf of bread lies here.
3101.description: A crusty loaf of freshly baked bread, still warm from the oven.

3102.name: waterskin
3102.description: A sturdy leather waterskin for carrying water on long journeys.

3103.name: fountain stone
3103.room_desc: A small stone fountain bubbles here.
3103.description: A modest stone fountain provides fresh water to the market square.

3120.name: bone crown scepter
3120.room_desc: A scepter made of fused bones lies here, emanating foul energy.
3120.description: This grotesque scepter was fashioned by the Sewer King from the bones of his enemies. Dark magic pulses through it.

3121.name: ratking crown
3121.short_desc: the Crown of the Rat King
3121.room_desc: A crown of yellowed bones lies here.
3121.description: This crown grants the wearer dominion over vermin. Rats seem to bow in its presence.

3122.name: plague ring
3122.room_desc: A tarnished ring pulses with sickly green light.
3122.description: This ring was forged in disease and death. Its wearer becomes immune to common poisons.

3123.name: shadow dagger
3123.room_desc: A dagger of pure darkness lies here, drinking in the light.
3123.description: This dagger was forged from solidified shadow. It seems to hunger for blood.

3124.name: shadow cloak
3124.room_desc: A cloak woven from living darkness pools on the ground.
3124.description: This cloak seems to bend light around itself. The wearer becomes harder to see and hit.

3125.name: assassin boots
3125.room_desc: A pair of jet-black boots lies here.
3125.description: These boots make no sound when walking. Perfect for those who prefer to strike unseen.

3126.name: guardian hammer
3126.room_desc: A massive stone hammer covered in glowing runes lies here.
3126.description: This hammer was wielded by the Ancient Guardian for millennia. The runes carved into it still pulse with protective magic.

3127.name: runic shield
3127.room_desc: A shield of carved stone radiates protective energy.
3127.description: Carved from the same stone as the Ancient Guardian, this shield bears runes of protection that glow when danger approaches.

3128.name: ancient amulet
3128.room_desc: A glowing amulet of incredible power lies here.
3128.description: This amulet predates recorded history. It thrums with raw magical power. Legends say it was worn by the first archmage.

3130.name: meat pie
3130.room_desc: A delicious-looking meat pie sits here.
3130.description: A flaky-crusted pie filled with seasoned meat and vegetables.

3131.name: cheese wheel
3131.room_desc: A wheel of cheese lies here.
3131.description: Aged for months, this cheese has a sharp, rich flavor.

3132.name: apple
3132.room_desc: A shiny red apple sits here.
3132.description: A crisp, fresh apple from the orchards outside the city.

3133.name: wine bottle
3133.room_desc: A dusty bottle of wine lies here.
3133.description: An excellent vintage from the southern vineyards.

3134.name: healing potion
3134.room_desc: A small red vial glows faintly.
3134.description: This red potion restores health when consumed.

3135.name: mana potion
3135.room_desc: A small blue vial shimmers with energy.
3135.description: This blue potion restores magical energy when consumed.

3136.name: torch
3136.room_desc: A torch lies on the ground.
3136.description: A simple wooden torch coated with pitch. It will provide light in dark places.

3137.name: rope
3137.room_desc: A coil of rope lies here.
3137.description: Fifty feet of hemp rope, useful for climbing or binding.

3138.name: bandages
3138.room_desc: A roll of bandages lies here.
3138.description: Clean linen bandages for treating wounds.

3200.name: vial of viper venom
3200.room_desc: A vial of viper venom lies here.
3200.description: Extracted from the fangs of the deadliest vipers, this venom causes excruciating pain and immediate tissue damage.

3201.name: vial of neurotoxin
3201.room_desc: A vial of yellow neurotoxin lies here.
3201.description: A paralytic toxin that blinds the target temporarily.

3202.name: vial of hemotoxin
3202.room_desc: A vial of crimson hemotoxin lies here.
3202.description: A blood poison that causes severe internal bleeding.

3210.name: a leather-bound chronicle
3210.room_desc: A leather-bound chronicle rests on a dusty desk.
3210.description: The cover reads "Chronicle of the First Wall" in faded ink.
3210.lore_text: "We raised the first wall of Garathorm with sweat, prayer, and borrowed stone from the giants. The walls did not merely keep danger out; they kept hope in."

3211.name: a sealed temple letter
3211.room_desc: A sealed letter lies tucked into a votive bowl.
3211.description: Wax bears the imprint of a stylized hammer.
3211.lore_title: Letter of the First High Priest
3211.lore_text: "Keep the reliquary hidden. Let only those who search with pure intent find the way beneath the temple."

3212.name: a watcher's ring
3212.room_desc: A steel ring etched with a tiny eye glints here.
3212.description: A simple steel band worn smooth from long service.

3213.name: a battered watch coffer
3213.room_desc: A battered watch coffer rests against the wall.
3213.description: Its hinges creak and the lock is stiff with rust.

3214.name: a rusted watch-key
3214.room_desc: A rusted iron key has been left here.
3214.description: An old key stamped with the watch sigil.

3215.name: dragon steak
3215.room_desc: A perfectly cooked dragon steak sits here, still sizzling.
3215.description: This thick cut of dragon meat is seared to perfection, radiating heat and a mouthwatering aroma. Eating it is said to grant the strength of dragons.
3215.food_message: The dragon's power surges through your muscles!

3216.name: pixie dust cake
3216.room_desc: A small cake dusted with glittering pixie dust rests here.
3216.description: This delicate confection sparkles with authentic pixie dust. Those who eat it report feeling lighter than air and incredibly quick.
3216.food_message: You feel light as a feather and quick as lightning!

3217.name: mindflayer brain
3217.room_desc: A preserved brain floats in a jar of strange fluid.
3217.description: This grotesque delicacy is prized by dark mages for the psionic residue it contains. Consuming it is said to enhance mental acuity... if you can stomach it.
3217.food_message: Alien thoughts flood your mind, expanding your consciousness!

3218.name: phoenix egg omelette
3218.room_desc: A golden omelette radiates warmth here.
3218.description: Made from the incredibly rare phoenix egg, this omelette glows with inner fire. Those who eat it are said to recover from wounds with supernatural speed.
3218.food_message: Warmth spreads through your body, accelerating your healing!

3219.name: giants stew
3219.room_desc: A massive cauldron of hearty stew steams here.
3219.description: This thick, meaty stew was made by giants using their secret recipe. A single bowl can fill even the hungriest adventurer and toughens the body.
3219.food_message: The hearty stew fortifies your constitution!

3220.name: ambrosia
3220.room_desc: A crystal vial of golden ambrosia glows softly here.
3220.description: The food of the gods themselves. This divine nectar restores both body and spirit, granting temporary blessings to all who consume it.
3220.food_message: Divine power flows through you! All your abilities are enhanced!

3221.name: shadowfruit
3221.room_desc: A fruit that seems to absorb light sits here.
3221.description: This rare fruit grows only in the deepest shadows. It tastes of midnight and secrets, and grants those who eat it the ability to move unseen.
3221.food_message: Shadows cling to you, making you harder to detect!

3222.name: battle ration
3222.room_desc: A magically preserved battle ration lies here.

3299.room_desc: A large quest board is mounted on the temple wall, covered in notices and contracts.
3299.readable_text:
=== QUEST BOARD - Garathorm Adventurer's Guild ===

BEGINNERS (Levels 1-10):
  Newbie Training Grounds — East of the Great Field (Level 1+)
  Light Forest — Speak with Ranger Thornwood at the forest edge (Level 3+)
  Haon-Dor Forest — South from the West Gate (Level 3+)

INTERMEDIATE (Levels 5-20):
  Great Northern Forest — North from the Great Field (Level 5+)
    Borin the Wilderness Guide has work for capable adventurers
  Orc Enclave — Scout Harken tracks orc patrols (Level 5+)
  Silversong Forest — Lyralei the Bard seeks protectors (Level 5+)
  Mines of Moria (Upper) — Grimjaw the Prospector at the mine entrance (Level 8+)
  City of Thalos — Captain Varro needs desert fighters (Level 10+)
  City Sewers — Skullcap lurks near the sewer grate (Level 10+)
  Dark Forest — Only the brave dare enter (Level 10+)

ADVANCED (Levels 15-35):
  Drow City — Zilara the Shadow Exile knows the way (Level 15+)
    Enter through the portal in the Deserted Warehouse
  Mines of Moria (Deep) — Grimjaw speaks of deeper horrors (Level 15+)
  Mindflayer's Lair — Professor Mindwell needs brave souls (Level 15+)
  Great Pyramid — Professor Khepri researches ancient secrets (Level 20+)
  Sewer Maze — The deepest sewers hold terrible secrets (Level 20+)

EXPERT (Levels 25-50):
  Necropolis — Paladin Dawnguard leads the crusade (Level 25+)
  Frostspire — Freja guards the frozen peaks (Level 25+)
  Dragon's Domain — Drakon the Dragon Hunter seeks allies (Level 30+)
  Plane of Eternal Chaos — Arcanist Veyla contains the rifts (Level 30+)

LEGENDARY (Levels 50-60):
  Castle Apocalypse — Sir Aldren the Undying guards the outer gate
    Only the realm's greatest heroes need apply
  Tunnel of Sticks — Reality itself is your enemy
    You have been warned.

Type 'quest list' to see your active quests.
Type 'talk <npc name>' when you find a quest giver.
